【UK analyst: Iran aims to prolong war to increase US 'pain'】Michael Stephens, senior research fellow at the Royal United Services Institute, said Iran is deliberately seeking to prolong the war because it does not view economic pressure as an existential threat to the regime. After nearly six months of fighting, Tehran is convinced the US will not mount a ground invasion and that "the survival threat has gone," so it is trying to accelerate operations to "make Trump feel greater pain" and prefers to "drag it out." Stephens said, contrary to pre-war expectations of imminent collapse after mass protests, Iran has not fallen and Washington appears to lack effective means to compel Tehran; Iranians can "continue to live in a stalemate" — suffering but not facing a survival crisis, which he described as the core problem for the US.

【Suezmax tanker Caroline grounded off southern Oman; 390 sq km oil slick, monsoon complicates rescue】Ambrey said specialists have boarded the Suezmax tanker Caroline, aground off the Al Hallaniyat Islands on Oman’s southern coast; rescue vessels, aircraft and equipment are en route. Omani state news reported an oil slick of about 390 sq km and said mainland beaches have been contaminated; the government environment agency is monitoring the leak. Monsoon-season seas and weather are expected to hamper salvage and response operations. Waters around the Al Hallaniyat Islands contain coral reefs, fish, nesting sea turtles and sightings of dolphins and whales.

【美大使稱圍困巴勒斯坦民房的以定居者是“恐怖分子”】美國駐以色列大使邁克·赫卡比13日在社交媒體上說，近日在約旦河西岸圍困巴勒斯坦居民的以色列定居者是“恐怖分子”。《以色列時報》13日報道說，以定居者自9日以來持續對約旦河西岸城市納布盧斯以南古斯拉村兩戶民房實施“封鎖”，阻止居民進出。赫卡比當天在社交媒體上回應此事時說，美國駐以色列大使館一直“高度介入”此事，以國防軍和以警方已“應要求”前往現場驅逐以“恐怖分子”。赫卡比稱，涉事以定居者行為屬於“犯罪行為”，是“旨在恐嚇、騷擾居民的駭人恐怖行為”，其行徑“令人作嘔”。赫卡比還說，美國駐以大使館“一直在向美國政府通報事態進展”。（新華社）

【India July trade deficit widens as imports surge】India's July trade deficit widened to $31.98 bln from $30.4 bln in June, above a median economist estimate of $30.5 bln, as imports outpaced exports. Exports rose 19.6% YoY to $44.24 bln while imports increased 17.5% YoY to $76.22 bln. Strong import growth signals resilient domestic demand ahead of the festival season: vehicle sales are at record levels, credit growth hit a two-year high and GST receipts are rising at double-digit rates. Commerce Ministry secretary Rajesh Agrawal said export gains were led by oil products, electronics, engineering goods, gems and jewellery, iron ore, meat, dairy and poultry and seafood, with strong performance in Spain, Australia, Kenya and ASEAN markets.

【Chip leaders lift KOSPI into technical bull market; Hormuz stalemate flagged as risk】South Korean stocks jumped on Thursday, lifting emerging market equities as a global AI trade rebound pushed the Seoul KOSPI into a technical bull market. Jefferies strategist Mohit Kumar said he remains comfortable with an overweight in AI, citing a strong earnings season and no sign of a capex slowdown. The KOSPI rose 3.2% on Thursday, roughly 22% above its July 30 low. Large-cap memory makers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix led gains, each up about 5%. Kumar warned geopolitics remains the main risk: the Strait of Hormuz remains closed — if the stalemate lasts weeks markets should digest it, but if it endures months markets would need to reprice.

【Alibaba open-sources Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B; FlagOS community completes multi-chip adaptation】Aug 13 — Alibaba has open-sourced the large-scale MoE model Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B. 【宏和科技：退回32304平方米土地使用權並終止6億元投資專案】宏和科技公告，公司於2026年8月12日召開第四屆董事會第二十次會議，審議透過《關於退回土地使用權暨終止對外投資的議案》，同意解除《電子級玻璃纖維布及玻纖紗生產專案投資協議》及相關協議，退回位於蒼溪縣百利產城一體化新區面積為32304平方米的國有土地使用權，並授權公司董事長辦理退回土地使用權及收回出讓價款311萬元等事宜。該地塊原計劃用於“年產7200萬米高效能電子級玻璃纖維布開發與生產專案”建設，專案投資金額約人民幣6億元。公司表示，本次終止對外投資後，土地使用權出讓價款收回將增加公司流動資金，預計不會對公司財務狀況和經營狀況產生重大不利影響。

【宏和科技：擬6.8億元債轉股方式向全資子公司增資】宏和科技公告稱，為滿足全資子公司黃石宏和業務經營需要，公司擬以債轉股方式對其增資6.8億元，註冊資本擬由17.2億元增至24億元。公司於8月12日召開董事會，審議透過該議案，尚需股東會審議。本次增資不構成關聯交易和重大資產重組。增資後，公司仍持有黃石宏和100%股權，有助於推進其業務發展，提升公司整體實力，但目標達成受多種因素影響。
【宏和科技：2026年上半年淨利潤3.79億元，同比增長334.32%】宏和科技公告，2026年上半年營業收入10.48億元，同比增長90.39%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤3.79億元，同比增長334.32%；扣非淨利潤3.73億元，同比增長350.88%。本期不進行利潤分配及公積金轉增股本。

【上海建科：2026年上半年營收19.44億元 淨利潤同比增22.93%】上海建科公告稱，2026年上半年，公司營收19.44億元，同比增長0.45%；利潤總額4179.45萬元，同比增長14.32%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤3077.01萬元，同比增長22.93%。截至報告期末，公司總資產58.82億元，較上年度末減少8.01%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨資產37.96億元，較上年度末減少1.93%。

【宏和科技：2026年上半年電子級玻璃纖維布營收10.33億元】宏和科技公告稱，2026年1-6月，公司電子級玻璃纖維布產量9051.40萬米，銷售量8668.89萬米，營業收入10.33億元。該產品平均售價從2025年同期的4.81元/米漲至11.91元/米，變動比率147.61%。主要原料電子級玻璃纖維紗平均進價從2025年同期的20.40元/Kg漲至67.16元/Kg，變動比率229.21%。報告期內無其他重大影響事項，經營資料未經審計。

【阿里巴巴開源Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B，眾智FlagOS社群同步完成多晶片適配】8月13日訊息，阿里巴巴開源超大規模MoE 模型Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B，眾智FlagOS社群同步完成多晶片適配。目前，Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B已在平頭哥、英偉達、摩爾執行緒、華為昇騰、沐曦、崑崙芯、海光、清微智慧、燧原等9家AI晶片上完成基於FlagOS 統一開源技術棧的多芯適配、精度對齊與部署驗證。
【中遠海控：2026年8月13日回購150萬股 耗資2294.39萬元】中遠海控公告稱，2026年8月13日，公司透過上海證券交易所回購股份150萬股，佔有關事件前現有已發行股份的0.0119%，每股最高購回價15.4元，最低購回價15.17元，付出價格總額2294.39萬元。此外，7月7日至8月12日期間公司也進行過多次股份回購。

【China expediting fourth national air-quality action plan, vice minister says】Vice Minister Xu Bijiu of the Ministry of Ecology and Environment said at a State Council Information Office briefing on the 13th that China is expediting the drafting of a new round of sustained air-quality improvement measures—the fourth iteration of the so-called ‘Ten Measures’. He noted three prior national plans were issued in 2013, 2018 and 2023. Data cited by Xu show national average PM2.5 fell to 28 µg/m3 in 2025, down 59% versus 2013, and the share of heavy-pollution days dropped to 0.9%, the lowest level since monitoring began.

【等紅燈不計入外賣配送時長 北京部分割槽域9月試執行】記者從13日北京市市場監督管理局組織的平臺經濟協商對話會上瞭解到，三家外賣平臺將在京執行“紅燈停表”。停車等紅燈耽誤送餐，是困擾外賣騎手的難題之一。美團、淘寶閃購、京東三家平臺將實行的“紅燈停表”機制下，騎手等紅燈的時長在考核時間中順延。新機制將於9月在北京朝陽、通州、經開區等部分割槽域試執行，後續將逐步推廣至全市範圍。（新華社）

【我國正抓緊制定新一輪空氣質量持續改善行動方案】生態環境部副部長徐必久表示，我國正在抓緊制定新一輪空氣質量持續改善行動方案，也是第四個“大氣十條”。他是在13日國務院新聞辦公室舉行的“開局起步‘十五五’”系列主題新聞釋出會上介紹這一情況的。徐必久介紹，黨的十八大以來，我國先後印發實施三個“大氣十條”，分別是2013年的《大氣汙染防治行動計劃》、2018年的《打贏藍天保衛戰三年行動計劃》、2023年的《空氣質量持續改善行動計劃》，推動我國空氣質量明顯改善。資料顯示，2025年全國PM2.5濃度降到28微克/立方米，與2013年相比下降59%，重汙染天數比例降到0.9%，是有監測以來的最好水平。他說，當前，我國大氣汙染治理成效不充分、不穩固、不平衡的問題依然突出，空氣質量改善仍然處於從“明顯改善”向“全面改善”過渡的關鍵期。第四個“大氣十條”將重點在“更高、更準、更科學”上下功夫。（新華社）

【鑑於美聯儲和經濟資料的不確定性 摩根資產管理更青睞美國以外的債券】摩根資產管理更看好美國以外的債券市場，美聯儲政策和經濟資料的不確定性，令美國國債前景不太明朗。“目前我實際上更看好美國以外的市場，”摩根資產管理固定收益國際投資總監Iain Stealey在接受彭博電視採訪時表示“我更傾向於買入歐洲短期債券，尤其是英國債券。我認為英國央行並不急於加息”同時也青睞實際收益率高的新興市場他表示，“考慮到這些央行過去幾年的政策表現，甚至可以說它們更具公信力”在日本市場，Stealey則青睞收益率曲線平坦化交易策略。
【福賽科技：股價異動系機器人零部件業務處於早期階段，2026年上半年未形成訂單】福賽科技公告，公司股票2026年8月11日、12日、13日連續三個交易日收盤價格漲幅偏離值累計達到31.72%，屬於股票交易異常波動。經核查，公司基本面近期未發生重大變化，機器人零部件產品處於早期研發、小批次試製及送樣階段，2026年上半年未形成正式訂單，未實現收入與利潤。

【農業農村部組織專業力量指導颱風災後恢復生產】記者13日從農業農村部獲悉，近日，農業農村部組織專業力量，派出6個工作組和11個科技小分隊赴浙江等受颱風影響較重地區，指導災後恢復生產工作。種植業方面，農業農村部調配排澇救災機具，指導相關省份疏浚560萬畝農田溝渠，及時搶排田間積水，修復受損設施，減輕漬澇影響；推動落實秋糧抗逆防災噴施作業，促進作物恢復生長。畜牧業方面，印發洪澇災區動物防疫技術指南，指導地方開展死亡畜禽無害化處理和消毒滅源，防範次生疫情。漁業方面，統籌協調東海區上海、江蘇、浙江、福建4省（市）調整捕撈漁船出海時間，避開風雨影響；組織近4萬名船東船長線上接受漁船安全課程培訓，提升安全生產技能、壓實安全生產責任。（新華社）

【諾和新元擬收購MicroBioGen剩餘股權】8月13日訊息，諾和新元已於近日簽署協議，擬收購澳大利亞生物技術公司MicroBioGen。後者在工業用酵母菌株領域擁有領先的科研實力，在生物乙醇方面尤為突出。此次收購是在諾和新元2013年投資MicroBioGen、目前持有其23%股權的基礎上作出的進一步佈局，將深化雙方在生物乙醇生產領域進行的先進酵母解決方案合作。根據協議，諾和新元將繼續支援MicroBioGen現有的合作伙伴，確保相關合作平穩延續。

【SpaceX安然度過華爾街頗為忌憚的首輪解禁 股價短短五日上漲35%】自SpaceX於6月上市以來，華爾街一直對8月6日心存擔憂。當天，限制早期投資者出售股票的首個鎖定期到期，大量股票勢將湧入市場。事實證明，這種擔憂並無必要。自解禁期結束以來，SpaceX股價一路飆升，短短五個交易日上漲35%，市值增加約5000億美元，並重新升破135美元的首發價。這波漲勢與市場此前對拋售潮即將來臨的擔憂形成反差，也讓投資者更樂觀地認為，未來幾輪解禁帶來的衝擊可能不會像之前擔心的那麼嚴重。持有SpaceX股票的Loxahatchee Capital管理合夥人兼投資委員會負責人Andrew Plum表示：“我們已經跨過了重大障礙，也就是未知本身。市場往往會提前反映一個負面事件，甚至可能反映過度；等事情真正發生時，結果通常沒有此前定價或預期的那麼糟。”

Latvia Current Account Gap Largest Since 2008 — Latvia’s current account deficit widened to EUR 334 million in June 2026, compared with EUR 266 million in the corresponding month of the previous year, marking the largest deficit since April 2008. The goods account shortfall also increased to EUR 509 million from EUR 470 million, while the primary income gap widened sharply to EUR 105 million compared with EUR 31 million a year earlier. Meanwhile, the services account surplus grew to EUR 182 million from EUR 160 million, while the secondary income balance improved to a surplus of EUR 97 million from EUR 75 million a year earlier.

【濰宿高鐵全線控制性工程建設取得新進展】記者從雄安高速鐵路有限公司瞭解到，作為國家高速鐵路網京滬輔助通道的重要組成部分，濰宿高鐵建設正在持續推進，全線控制性工程建設取得新進展。在山東日照，由中鐵十一局承建的濰宿高鐵諸城濰河特大橋跨濰河雙線連續梁日前順利合龍。這一連續梁全長約401米，是濰宿高鐵濰坊至日照段最長的連續梁。在山東臨沂，由中鐵十四局承建的控制性工程焦店村特大橋跨燕子河連續梁近日也成功實現合龍，為後續架樑施工、無砟軌道鋪設及全線快速推進奠定堅實基礎。（新華社）

【茶花股份：2026年上半年營收11.95億元 同比增長219.40%】茶花股份公告稱，2026年上半年公司積極推進“提質增效重回報”行動方案。雙主業協同發展，實現營收11.95億元，同比增長219.40%，淨利潤859.66萬元。報告期內，公司取得8項外觀專利，修訂多項管理制度，實施2025年度利潤分配，每10股派發現金紅利0.20元，共計派發現金紅利483.64萬元。公司還累計披露臨時公告23份，組織召開業績說明會1場，回覆投資者問詢6條。後續方案執行或受政策、市場等因素影響。

【惠天熱電：股票交易異常波動 上半年預虧9000萬-1.25億元】惠天熱電公告稱，公司股票於2026年8月12 - 13日連續兩個交易日收盤價格漲幅偏離值累計超20%，屬異常波動。公司預計2026年上半年歸母淨利潤為 - 1.25億元至 - 9000萬元。此外，公司法庫200MW風力發電專案獲核准，擬投資14.05億元建設供熱工程，待股東會審議；控股子公司涉1.43億元訴訟，8月19日開庭。經核查，公司無應披露未披露事項。

【日月明：完成5758.30萬元股份回購 預計股本將變動】日月明公告稱，截至2026年8月12日，公司完成股份回購，實際回購股份218.45萬股，佔總股本2.73%，最高成交價28.20元/股，最低成交價24.55元/股，成交總金額5758.30萬元。本次回購符合方案及法規要求，不會對公司產生重大不利影響。回購股份將在公告披露12個月後出售，3年內完成，若未售完將登出。若全部登出，公司總股本將從8000萬股減至7781.55萬股。
【福建福安一船廠發生爆炸 初步瞭解1人失聯10人受傷】記者瞭解到，8月13日13時許，福建福安市甘棠鎮華海船廠一船舶著火。在消防員現場處置過程中，現場發生爆炸。初步瞭解，已造成1名消防員失聯，另有10人受傷。 (央視新聞)
【土沙巴三國將建政治軍事合作機制】土耳其國防部今天（8月13日）表示，土耳其、沙烏地阿拉伯和巴基斯坦將根據上週簽署的共同防務協議，建立政治與軍事合作機制，並將深化國防工業領域的合作。土耳其國防部稱，相關機制將涵蓋三國的國防部長、外交部長及軍隊總參謀長。此外，根據該協議，三國還計劃開展聯合軍事演習，合作範圍可能涵蓋國防工業的聯合生產與技術共享。（CCTV國際時訊）

【IMF loan conditions anger Kyiv; Zelenskiy singles out central bank governor】People familiar said President Zelenskiy has grown increasingly unhappy with central bank governor Andrii Pyshnyi, viewing him as too close to the IMF and insufficiently supportive of the wartime economy. The IMF attached an unpopular set of conditions to loans to Kyiv, which has intensified the president’s ire and made Pyshnyi a focal point. Sources said Zelenskiy does not currently plan to remove Pyshnyi and sees no clear successor. The tension dates to last winter, when the IMF approved an $8.1 billion programme that required key commitments, including tax increases that drew sharp criticism from MPs and the public.

【雙良節能與南網綜合能源廣東公司簽訂戰略合作協議】據雙良節能訊息，8月12日，雙良節能與南方電網綜合能源（廣東）有限公司(簡稱“南網綜合能源廣東公司”)正式簽訂戰略合作協議。雙方將充分發揮各自的資源、資本及平臺優勢，以市場為導向，以專案為依託，聚焦零碳園區及工廠、工業/建築節能、城市供熱領域開發和建設，建立全方位、多元化的戰略合作關係。

【Tankers shut transponders to evade oversight; Iraq exports via Hormuz rise to ~2mln bpd】Iraq's State Oil Marketing Organization (SOMO) said an Abu Dhabi energy firm is among purchasers exporting Iraqi crude through the Strait of Hormuz. Earlier reports said ADNOC’s trading arm has transshipped Iraqi cargoes to Asian buyers via Hormuz, a practice that typically involves tankers switching off transponders to avoid detection and has kept Middle East oil flowing to global markets. SOMO head Ali Nizar said Iraq’s exports through the Strait jumped to about 2 mln bpd this month, up from levels in the months after the Iran war began but still below pre-conflict roughly 3.4 mln bpd.

【吉位元：2026年上半年營收37.27億元 擬分紅7.18億元】吉位元公告稱，2026年上半年營收37.27億元，同比增長48.01%；淨利潤10.92億元，同比增長69.31%。公司擬以股權登記日的總股本扣除回購專戶中已回購股份後的股本為基數，向全體股東每10股派發現金紅利100元（含稅），合計派發現金紅利預計為7.18億元（含稅），占上半年淨利潤的65.74%。自2017年上市以來，公司現金分紅累計金額達81.39億元，為首次公開發行股票融資淨額的9.05倍。

India Trade Gap Larger Than Anticipated — India’s trade deficit widened to $31.98 billion in July 2026, up from $27.5 billion in the same month of the previous year and surpassing market forecasts of $30.2 billion. It was the largest trade shortfall since January, as imports jumped by 18% annually to an all-time high of $76.2 billion, reflecting higher oil, fuel, and coal prices amid rising tensions in the Middle East. Exports advanced by 19.2% to $44.2 billion.

【報告稱長江儲存快閃記憶體出貨量超過鎧俠 但銷售額仍排名第五】市場研究機構Counterpoint Research的資料顯示，按全球NAND快閃記憶體位元出貨量計算，長江儲存已經追上備受投資者青睞的鎧俠，同時進一步縮小了與三星電子和SK海力士之間的差距。鎧俠目前將業務重點放在面向美國資料中心運營商的高階儲存產品上。Counterpoint分析師MS Hwang和Neil Shah在報告中表示，鎧俠出貨量排名下降，部分原因在於伺服器產品價格較高。不過，如果按照銷售額而不是出貨量計算，長江儲存仍落後於美光科技和鎧俠，排名全球第五。分析師指出，長江儲存雖然已經具備相當大的出貨規模，但“規模尚未轉化為營收”。隨著人工智慧應用快速普及，企業對於低功耗、高能效資料儲存的需求正在上升，尤其是固態硬碟(SSD)。第二季度，SSD已佔全部NAND快閃記憶體出貨量的接近一半。根據Counterpoint的資料，一年前，企業級SSD僅佔NAND出貨量的26%，如今這一比例幾乎翻了一番。

【沙特調整原油出口路線】最新資料顯示，近期經由霍爾木茲海峽通行的船舶數量，已經降至近三個月以來的低位。目前不僅是霍爾木茲海峽，曼德海峽也正成為新的安全風險點。沙烏地阿拉伯正加大調整原油出口路線。克普勒的資料顯示，8月份，埃及地中海港口、西迪基里爾的原油日均出口量躍升至了大約230萬桶，較7月翻了一倍多，也遠高於過去兩年的水平。克普勒稱，其中大部分原油出口來自沙特，分析認為，這並不是沙特的短期應急之舉，同時繞開霍爾木茲海峽和曼德海峽，可能會成為沙特原油出口的新趨勢。 展望後市，高盛認為，在中東局勢逐步緩和的基準情景下，第四季度布倫特原油均價可能會在大約每桶80美元。但是，分析認為油價風險仍然偏向上行。（央視財經）

Croatia Producer Inflation Eases to 4-Month Low — Producer prices in Croatia increased by 4.9% year-on-year in July 2026, easing from 5.7% in the previous month, marking the lowest reading in four months. The slowdown was mainly driven by a softer increase in mining and quarrying prices (13.9% vs. 18.5% in June), largely reflecting a slower rise in crude petroleum and natural gas extraction (19.5% vs. 30.8%). Manufacturing producer price inflation also moderated (4.3% vs. 5.3%), due to a sharp easing in prices of coke and refined petroleum products (38.7% vs. 54.6%). In contrast, inflation accelerated slightly for electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply (5.4% vs. 4.7%), while price growth also edged up for water supply, sewerage, waste management and remediation activities (2.0% vs. 1.8%). On a monthly basis, producer prices declined by 0.2%, easing from a 0.3% decline in the previous month.

Euro Area Industrial Output Stalls in June — Industrial production in the Euro Area was unchanged in June 2026, after a 0.3% rise in May and compared with market expectations of a 0.1% decrease. Output rebounded for durable consumer goods (0.3% vs -1.3% in May) and continued to increase for non-durable consumer (3% vs 3.3%) and energy (1.5% vs 2.6%). On the other hand, production fell for intermediate goods (-0.8% vs -0.2%) and capital goods (-1.4% vs 0.5%). Among the bloc’s largest economies, industrial production rose 0.2% in Germany, was unchanged in France and declined 0.7% in Spain. Year-over-year, industrial production increased 0.1%, after a 0.1% decrease in June.

【杭州公安偵破全國首起“護劇”敲詐勒索案】杭州市公安局通報，近日成功偵破全國首起以“護劇”為名實施網路輿情敲詐勒索案件，打掉了依託自媒體賬號操控輿論、脅迫影視劇組及藝人付費消災的職業化犯罪團伙。2026年5月2日，杭州公安網安民警在日常網路巡查中發現異常線索，多名影視類自媒體賬號在影視劇上線宣發節點集中釋出負面內容，待輿情發酵後又快速刪除，固定化的操作模式引起警方警覺。經專案組深入偵查，以李某、廖某為首的犯罪團伙逐漸浮出水面，該團伙運營一批粉絲總量達2020餘萬的微博賬號，專門瞄準新劇開播、綜藝宣發關鍵時段，捏造散佈不實負面資訊，多賬號聯動炒作話題、煽動粉絲對立製造輿論壓力。待影視公司、藝人經紀團隊主動溝通後，嫌疑人並不直接提“刪帖”，而是以“提供宣傳服務”“輿情最佳化合作”的名義進行談判，將刪帖包裝成“護劇”商業宣傳行為，開口索要高額費用，並透過加大發帖頻率、擴大傳播範圍的方式，形成持續輿論施壓，直至對方“花錢消災”平息風波。（央視新聞）

【洛陽鉬業：將於8月21日召開2026年半年度業績說明會】洛陽鉬業公告稱，公司擬於8月19日盤後釋出2026年半年度報告，並於8月21日10:00 - 11:00舉行半年度業績說明會。會議將以網路互動形式在上海證券交易所上證路演中心進行。參加人員包括公司董事長、獨立董事、首席財務官及董事會秘書。投資者可在說明會期間線上參與提問，也可於8月14日至20日16:00前預徵集提問。說明會結束後，投資者可透過上證路演中心檢視情況及內容。
【中國神華：7月商品煤產量4340萬噸，同比-3.1%】中國神華公告，2026年7月商品煤產量4340萬噸，同比-3.1%，煤炭銷售量5310萬噸，同比-4.5%；總發電量27.22十億千瓦時，同比-5.3%，總售電量25.41十億千瓦時，同比-5.5%。航運貨運量1290萬噸，同比-53.4%。

【烏稱已提出結束衝突新建議 俄稱“不瞭解”】當地時間8月13日，俄羅斯副外長里亞布科夫表示，俄方不瞭解烏克蘭總統澤連斯基關於結束俄烏衝突的提議。里亞布科夫稱，美國總統特使威特科夫和特朗普女婿庫什納到訪俄羅斯一事仍在關注之中，一旦美方代表團的計劃明確，俄方能夠迅速安排接待。當天稍早前，烏克蘭總統澤連斯基再次強調，烏方已向美國提交俄烏衝突和平程序的新方案，目前尚未獲得美方的預期支援。澤連斯基還呼籲美方進一步介入相關和平談判、推動局勢降溫。此外，澤連斯基重申拒絕將烏軍撤出頓巴斯作為結束衝突的條件。（央視新聞）
【遠洋集團：7月協議銷售額約為人民幣8.5億元】遠洋集團8月13日公告，7月協議銷售額約為人民幣8.5億元；協議銷售樓面面積約為61,300平方米；協議銷售均價為每平方米約人民幣13,900元。前7月累計協議銷售額約為人民幣89.9億元；累計協議銷售樓面面積約為737,500平方米；累計協議銷售均價為每平方米約人民幣12,200元。

【Shenzhen heatwave sets multiple records】Since Aug 6 and as of 16:00 on Aug 13 the heatwave has lasted eight days. The heat intensity index reached 22.1, the third-strongest since 2008 and in the top 5%, classified as extreme. Futian national basic meteorological station recorded four consecutive days at or above 35°C; Aug 8–10 saw three straight days of 36°C or higher — the third occurrence since continuous records began in 1953, tying the historical record.

【北京市水務局與高德達成合作，近800個官方監測點接入“積水地圖”】近日，北京市水務局與阿里巴巴集團旗下高德達成合作，將近800個官方積水監測點位的資料接入高德“積水地圖”，實現積水深度實時更新並精確到釐米。（新浪科技）

【Shanghai backs property managers to contract with eldercare providers and introduce professional care into residential communities】Shanghai Civil Affairs Bureau and Shanghai Housing Management Bureau issued an implementation plan to advance “property+eldercare” services. Districts and neighborhood offices will select suitably mature residential communities and guide property managers to develop locally adapted forms of property-plus-eldercare. The plan supports property managers signing cooperation agreements with professional eldercare institutions to bring trained services into residential communities. Property firms that wish to provide home-and-community eldercare are encouraged to set up dedicated eldercare departments or form independent home/community eldercare service entities to offer diversified, professional services to owners.
【華虹宏力：執行副總裁周衛平離任】華虹宏力公告，公司執行副總裁周衛平因工作原因，申請辭去公司相關工作及職務，離任後不再擔任公司及控股子公司其他職務。

【上海：支援物業服務企業與養老服務機構簽訂合作協議 將專業養老服務引入住宅小區】上海市民政局、上海市房屋管理局印發《關於進一步推進“物業+養老”服務的實施方案》。其中提到，各區、各街鎮結合實際，選取條件成熟的住宅小區，指導物業服務企業因地制宜發展多種形式的“物業+養老”服務。支援物業服務企業與養老服務機構簽訂合作協議，將專業養老服務引入住宅小區。鼓勵有意從事居家社群養老服務的物業服務企業，根據自身條件，透過設立養老服務部門、成立獨立的居家社群養老服務機構等方式，為業主提供多樣化、專業化的居家社群養老服務。

【李強簽署國務院令 公佈《國務院關於修改和廢止部分行政法規的決定》】國務院總理李強日前簽署國務院令，公佈《國務院關於修改和廢止部分行政法規的決定》，自2026年8月15日起施行。為全面有效貫徹實施《中華人民共和國生態環境法典》，確保生態環境法律制度體系邏輯統一、規則協調，國務院對涉及的行政法規進行了清理，決定對12部行政法規的部分條款予以修改，對3部行政法規予以廢止。修改《全國汙染源普查條例》、《生態環境監測條例》等行政法規，相關行政法規中引用的法律將於今年8月15日生態環境法典施行之日廢止的，相應將引用的法律名稱統一修改為生態環境法典；相關行政法規關於法律責任等具體事項的規定與生態環境法典不一致的，依照生態環境法典的規定作相應修改。廢止《中華人民共和國防治陸源汙染物汙染損害海洋環境管理條例》等行政法規，更好適應高質量發展和生態文明建設的新要求。 (新華社)

【匈牙利在多瑙河河床建壩 保障核電站執行】據央視新聞，匈牙利總理毛焦爾12日表示，匈牙利政府已下令在保克什和杜納聖貝內德克之間的多瑙河河床上建造水下導流壩，來保證保克什核電站在多瑙河低水位情況下的冷卻水供應。這項措施最終可能使當地水位上升約1米。此外，為防止核電站在導流壩建成前就被迫停運，匈牙利政府還準備了兩艘駁船作為臨時方案，必要時將沉沒這兩艘船，讓多瑙河水位暫時提高最多20釐米。保克什核電站位於匈牙利首都布達佩斯以南約100公里，是匈牙利唯一核電站，也是匈牙利重要的電力來源。此前由於多瑙河水位過低、冷卻水源不足，保克什核電站多個機組停運。

【京東物流：2026年第二季度收入641.02億元，同比增長24.3%】京東物流公告，截至2026年6月30日止三個月，收入641.02億元，同比增長24.3%；期間利潤24.06億元，同比增長2.5%。截至2026年6月30日止六個月，收入1246.83億元，同比增長26.5%；期間利潤32.71億元，同比增長10.5%。董事會不建議派發中期股息。

【上港集團：簽署7.8億洋山四期碼頭經營性資產租賃合同】上港集團公告稱，公司及尚東分公司與同盛集團8月12日簽署《洋山四期碼頭經營性資產租賃合同》，租賃期限自2026年1月1日至12月31日，租金7.80億元（不含增值稅），期滿無異議自動續期一年，次數不限。後續租金按公式動態調整，超董事會許可權需重新決策。本次交易構成關聯交易，不構成重大資產重組，已獲董事會等審議透過，無需股東會審議和外部部門批准。
【小熊電器：2026年上半年淨利潤1.2億元，同比下降41.30%】小熊電器公告，2026年上半年營業收入23.49億元，同比下降7.34%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤1.2億元，同比下降41.30%，2025年同期淨利潤2.05億元。歸屬於上市公司股東的扣除非經常性損益的淨利潤1.09億元，同比下降41.59%。公司計劃不派發現金紅利，不送紅股，不以公積金轉增股本。

【貴安威邁爾今年已完成1800臺機器人生產】“這批AMR潛伏式搬運機器人是根據客戶產線的高度和重量定製的，相較以往的產品體積要大一些、身高高一些，可以實現1.2噸的載重運輸。”威邁爾科技公關事務部主任吳霖介紹，今年截至目前已完成1800臺機器人的生產，應用於汽車製造、3C電子等行業，部分產品銷往印尼、越南等海外市場。當前，全球機器人產業正加速向具身智慧方向發展，為進一步聚焦機器人技術創新與突破，8月以來，威邁爾科技正式啟動本地研發團隊組建工作，目前正面向社會及高校廣泛招聘相關技術人才。（貴州日報）

【整治食品新增劑濫用 2.3萬餘件超範圍、超限量使用案件被查處】自去年4月國務院食安辦等六部門聯合部署開展食品新增劑濫用問題綜合治理以來，各地市場監管部門聚焦重點食品品類和關鍵生產加工環節，整治食品新增劑濫用違法行為，綜合治理工作取得顯著成效。各地市場監管部門以乳製品、肉製品、水產製品、澱粉及澱粉製品、食用植物油、飲料、複合調味料為重點，聚焦食品生產和餐飲加工過程中食品新增劑超範圍、超限量使用突出問題，加大監督抽檢力度，嚴厲查處防腐劑、甜味劑、著色劑濫用等突出違法行為。全國共查辦超範圍、超限量使用食品新增劑案件23603件，涉案總金額4362萬元，罰沒金額1.45億元，其中278件移送公安機關依法追究刑事責任，對食品新增劑濫用等違法行為形成強大震懾。下一步，市場監管部門將結合監管中發現的突出問題，持續加大監督執法力度，聚焦奶茶、肉類熟食、糕點、麵食、酒類等重點品種深入推進綜合治理，持續推動企業落實食品安全主體責任，規範食品新增劑使用行為，依法查處重點案件、曝光典型案例，確保綜合治理取得實效。

【中國平安：將於8月21日召開2026年中期業績釋出會】中國平安公告稱，公司擬於8月21日在上海證券交易所網站披露2026年中期報告，並於當日中午11:45-12:45召開業績釋出會，以網路直播形式進行，直播地址為全景網和上證路演中心。參加人員包括董事長馬明哲等。投資者可於8月17日23:59前發郵件至指定郵箱提問，8月21日可登陸直播平臺觀看釋出會，8月24日起可在公司網站觀看相關影片。

Namibia Inflation Rate Stable at Near 2-Year High of 4.4% — The annual inflation rate in Namibia stood at 4.4% in July 2026, the highest level since August 2024, unchanged from June. Transportation was the main source of price pressure, rising 9.3%, followed by hotels, cafés and restaurants (6.2%) and recreation and culture (5.6%), while housing & utilities (4.8%) and health (4.8%) also recorded steep increases. On a monthly basis, the CPI edged up by 0.1%, after a 0.3% increase in the month before.
【德石股份：取得兩項發明專利證書】德石股份公告稱，公司近日取得國家智慧財產權局頒發的2項發明專利證書，分別為“一種模組化可移動式拆裝架”和“定子襯膠用橡膠組合物以及馬達總成”，授權公告日均為2026年8月11日。前者即將投入實際應用，可解決傳統固定式拆裝架痛點；後者尚未實際應用，可解決定子襯膠與金屬介面脫粘問題。上述專利不會對近期生產經營產生重大影響，但利於完善智慧財產權保護體系。
【微光股份：擬以4000萬元-8000萬元回購公司股份】微光股份公告，擬以不低於4000萬元人民幣(含)且不超過8000萬元人民幣(含)回購公司股份，回購價格不超過人民幣42元/股(含)。回購股份的用途為股權激勵或員工持股計劃，若公司未能在回購完成之後36個月內將回購股份全部轉讓給員工，未轉讓的回購股份將履行相關程式予以登出並減少公司註冊資本。
【德石股份：2026年上半年淨利潤3161.53萬元，同比降30.00%】德石股份公告，2026年上半年營業收入2.59億元，同比下降6.23%。歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤3161.53萬元，同比下降30.00%。扣非淨利潤3018.01萬元，同比下降23.44%。公司計劃不派發現金紅利，不送紅股，不以公積金轉增股本。
【協創資料：2026年上半年淨利潤18.63億元，同比增長331.11%】協創資料公告，2026年上半年實現營業總收入126.41億元，同比增長155.69%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤18.63億元，同比增長331.11%；扣非淨利潤18.61億元，同比增長343.42%。基本每股收益3.85元。

【江蘇博雲：2026年上半年淨利潤5606.51萬元，同比增0.29%】江蘇博雲公告，2026年上半年營業收入3.25億元，同比增長13.61%。歸母淨利潤5606.51萬元，同比增長0.29%。扣非淨利潤5437.55萬元，同比下降3.91%。利潤分配預案：每10股派現3元。

【樂普醫療：持股5%以上股東擬非公開發行不超6億元可交換債】樂普醫療公告稱，持股5%以上股東七二五所擬以其所持公司部分A股股票為標的，面向專業投資者非公開發行科技創新可交換公司債券。截至公告披露日，七二五所持公司股份244,063,788股，佔總股本比例13.24%，本次可交換債券擬募集資金規模不超6億元（含）。該發行事項已獲深交所無異議函，最終發行方案將根據市場狀況確定。公司將及時履行資訊披露義務。

【上汽通用五菱：華境S不存在網傳所謂“設計缺陷”，公司已報案】8月13日，華境汽車釋出宣告稱，自8月8日起，公司留意到個別社交平臺賬號釋出“華境S存在設計缺陷，前雙叉臂有嚴重設計問題”等言論。華境S底盤設計嚴格依據國家標準及行業法規要求開展，已透過全部法規要求的測試驗證，不存在網傳所謂“設計缺陷”。對於蓄意編造、傳播不實資訊損害上汽通用五菱商譽的行為，公司將依法追究其個人或組織的法律責任。此外，公司發現有人員在華境S車友群內有組織地釋出不實資訊，詆譭公司產品聲譽。目前公司已固定相關證據並向公安機關報案，對任何蓄意編造、傳播不實資訊、損害上汽通用五菱商業信譽的個人及組織，將依法追究其法律責任。
【ST麥趣：延期至2026年8月28日披露半年度報告】ST麥趣公告稱，公司原定於2026年8月18日披露《2026年半年度報告》，因報告工作量大、過程繁雜，為完善編制和複核工作，向深交所申請後，將披露時間延期至2026年8月28日。公司對調整披露時間帶來的不便致歉。

【永貴電器：截至8月12日回購股份比例達2.0548%】永貴電器公告稱，公司於2026年7月21日透過回購股份方案，資金總額不低於1億元且不超過1.5億元，回購價不超24.94元/股。截至8月12日，公司以集中競價交易方式回購A股股份7991200股，佔總股本的2.0548%，最高成交價14.73元/股，最低成交價12.56元/股，成交總金額1.09億元。本次回購符合既定方案，後續將按計劃繼續實施並及時披露資訊。
【深圳市分割槽雷雨大風黃色預警訊號】深圳市氣象臺2026年08月13日16時50分發布光明區、珠江口和寶安區（松崗、石巖、福永、沙井、航城、福海、新橋、燕羅街道）雷雨大風黃色預警訊號，預計1小時內上述地區陣風可達8級或以上，並伴有強雷電。請落實各項防風防雨防雷電措施。（深圳天氣）

【花旗：降建滔積層板目標價至92港元，急跌後呈入市時機】花旗發表報告，建滔積層板自6月高位累瀉逾六成，認為現在是重新進場時機，料今年下半年盈利增長加快。該行料建板下半年純利同比升幅將加快至2.8倍(上半年同比升約2倍)。該行稱，留意到公司有三大正面催化劑，包括(1)在8月初起電子玻璃纖布成本通脹後，覆銅板(CCL)8月銷售均價通脹料介乎10%至15%；(2)在8月24日公佈業績後，市場焦點將轉至今年下半年盈利增長展望料較上半年加快；(3)建板8月啟動T型玻璃纖維布(T布)生產線。考慮公司上半年盈喜遜該行預期，加上市場對主要資料中心營運商的AI資本開支以及英偉達迴圈融資的憂慮加劇，下調建板2026至28年盈測介乎9%至14%；以目標市盈率22倍(較歷史均值高於1.5個標準差)計，目標價由130港元下調至92港元，降幅約29%，評級由“買入”調整至“買入/高風險”。

【楊元慶談股價：不能僅看季度業績，更應關注聯想的戰略方向和執行力】聯想集團披露2026/27財年第一季度財報業績。在溝通會上，聯想集團董事長兼CEO楊元慶表示，關注聯想股價不能僅看一個季度的業績，更應該看基礎性的因素，比如聯想的戰略方向、運營能力、執行力和創新。 “你要看我們是不是說到做到。最簡單的，我們說千億美元營收，5%的淨利潤率，給個PE，你來估算聯想的股價應該是多少，這是不是最簡單的方式？”楊元慶說道。（新浪科技）

【亞泰集團：股價異常波動 提示多項經營及退市風險】亞泰集團公告稱，公司股票於2026年8月11 - 13日波動較大，已達異常波動標準。公司目前生產經營正常，無應披露未披露重大事項。2025年度、2026年一季度及半年度預計淨虧損分別為20.40億元、2.25億元、5億元左右。截至7月25日，逾期債務本金及利息累計36.22億元，佔最近一期經審計歸母淨資產的585.19%。公司處於預重整程式，若重整申請被受理，股票將被實施退市風險警示，若重整失敗，股票面臨終止上市風險。此外，前期籌劃的重大資產出售事項可能中止或終止。
【中電聯數智公司與太極股份達成戰略合作】8月13日，中電聯（北京）數智科技有限公司（簡稱“中電聯數智公司”）與太極股份達成戰略合作。雙方將以電力公共資訊平臺為核心載體，立足各自核心優勢開展深度協同。雙方基於長期良好的合作基礎，立足電力行業數字化發展大局，達成全方位、深層次戰略合作，共同開啟電力資料要素創新發展、行業數智化升級的全新篇章。

Oman Inflation Accelerates in July — Oman's annual inflation rose to 3.2% in July 2026, up from 2.8% in the prior month. Food inflation rose to 7.3% from 6.1%, while transport inflation increased to 6.5% from 5.5%. Prices also rose faster for recreation and culture (0.4% vs 0.3%). Meanwhile, inflation remained elevated for furnishings (3.1%) and education (2.2%), while housing and utilities costs continued to decline, falling 0.6%. In contrast, inflation eased for restaurants and hotels (3.6% vs 4.6%) and health (1.7% vs 1.8%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices increased 0.7%, rebounding from a 0.6% decline in June.

【瑞銀：英特爾200億美元融資落地是對自身代工路線圖的強力背書】瑞銀髮布報告稱，英特爾本週宣佈的200億美元融資計劃，大機率已消除籠罩其股價的長期不確定因素。瑞銀分析師蒂莫西·阿庫裡(Timothy Arcuri)在給客戶的報告中指出，結合英特爾即將敲定的多項代工協議所附帶的預付款及財務承諾——據信谷歌已就EMIB-T技術達成合作，蘋果則涉及M系列晶片，此外還包括AMD、SpaceX及潛在的其他客戶——本輪融資足以支撐其代工業務的後續建設投入。阿庫裡總結道：“總體而言，我們認為此次融資行動是英特爾對自身代工路線圖充滿信心的強力背書。”阿庫裡對英特爾股票維持“中性”評級，但在融資訊息公佈後，將其目標價從121美元下調至112美元。

【華虹宏力：決定啟用新LOGO提升品牌形象】華虹宏力公告稱，根據公司發展戰略，為增強公司LOGO的識別度和傳播效果、提升品牌形象和影響力，公司決定啟用新LOGO。此次變更不會影響股東權利、業務運營或財務狀況，公司網站及相關宣傳資料內容將同步更改。

【華峰測控：“華峰轉債”轉股價格調整為335.79元/股】華峰測控公告稱，公司於2026年8月10日完成2024年限制性股票激勵計劃部分股份登記工作，向6名激勵物件定向發行47,072股，總股本由200,751,197股變更為200,798,269股。根據規定，“華峰轉債”轉股價格由335.86元/股調整為335.79元/股，自8月11日起生效。“華峰轉債”轉股期為2026年12月29日起至2032年6月22日，目前尚未進入轉股期，正常交易，不停牌。

【華潤雙鶴：全資子公司獲乳酸鈉林格沖洗液3000ml藥品註冊證書】華潤雙鶴公告，全資子公司上海長征富民金山製藥有限公司近日收到國家藥品監督管理局頒發的乳酸鈉林格沖洗液《藥品註冊證書》，該藥品註冊分類為化學藥品3類，規格3000ml，藥品批准文號為國藥準字H20265308，視同透過一致性評價，適用於允許使用無菌電解質溶液的一般沖洗。該藥品系與外部單位合作品種，研發及註冊上市階段費用50.64萬元由合作方承擔，未納入公司研發投入核算範圍。

【Zhongjin Gold: Reserve-verification exploration at Hubei Jilongshan mine starts】Zhongjin Gold said reserve-verification exploration at Hubei Jilongshan Gold Mining Co. began on Aug. 10, moving the project into substantive construction. The four-month survey includes a core drilling programme to complete 32 holes totalling 11,000m within two months. Preliminary estimates indicate the project could add about 2.4 mln t of ore, 2 t of gold and 4,500 t of copper.

【京東健康2026半年報：國內醫藥零售最大平臺利潤能力持續增強，收入穩健增長】8月13日，京東健康釋出2026年中期業績公告。2026年上半年，京東健康總收入為人民幣409億元，同比增長15.9%；非國際財務報告準則指標下（Non-IFRS）經營利潤35億元，同比增長40.3%。報告期內，京東健康持續強化醫藥供應鏈優勢，鞏固“新藥全網首發第一站”地位，同時以“AI+供應鏈”全場景賦能“醫—檢—診—藥”閉環，核心經營指標穩健增長。京東集團SEC委員、京東健康CEO曹冬表示，公司圍繞“體驗、成本、效率”推進長期戰略，深化自營供應鏈與醫療服務融合，推進AI在健康消費場景的應用落地，為使用者提供易得、便捷、優質且可負擔的健康方案。得益於經營效率提升與成本結構最佳化，京東健康利潤水平連續改善，展現出強勁經營韌性與高質量增長態勢。
【中金黃金：湖北雞籠山公司儲量核實探礦工程開工】據中金黃金訊息，8月10日上午，湖北雞籠山黃金礦業有限公司儲量核實探礦工程破土動工，標誌著該專案從謀劃決策、論證設計正式轉入實質性施工階段。此次勘查工程為期4個月，核心的鑽探施工計劃在兩個月內完成32個鑽孔、累計1.1萬米的進尺任務。經初步估算，該專案預計新增礦石量240萬噸，金金屬量2噸、銅金屬量4500噸。

【我國核電總裝機規模居世界第一 中國核電交出亮眼綠色答卷】今年，我國加大核電專案建設力度，57臺機組核准在建，在運和核準在建總裝機達1.35億千瓦。核電工程建設規模穩居世界第一。作為推動經濟社會綠色轉型的重要能源，我國核電以在全國電力裝機中不到2%的佔比，貢獻了近5%的發電量。廣東、福建、遼寧、海南等4個省份的核電發電量佔比均超過15%。核電已成為東部沿海地區重要的清潔能源供給來源。7月底，我國又新核准8臺核電機組，這也是“十五五”時期首批核准的核電專案。“十五五”期間，我國核電建設繼續保持“積極安全有序發展”的原則，穩步推進東部沿海核電帶建設，因地制宜推進核能綜合利用，穩步提升核電在能源電力消費中的比重。（央視財經）

【India doubles installed capacity to shore supply; transmission lag constrains delivery】India's peak power demand topped 270 GW for the first time, roughly 70% higher than a decade ago. Installed capacity has nearly doubled over 10 years to about 552 GW, with non‑fossil sources now exceeding 300 GW. The government plans roughly $109bn of transmission investment through 2032, but grid build‑out is slower and more complex than solar plant construction: transmission corridors require land, rights‑of‑way, towers, transformers and multiple approvals, and incomplete towers can stall entire lines. Generation growth has kept pace with demand growth, but delivery constraints heighten near‑term demand for transmission, storage and financially sustainable distribution to make power available where and when needed.

【美國30年期國債發行利率或創25年新高 高成本舉債恐成新常態】美國政府勢將以25年來最高的利率發行30年期國債。此前長期美債經歷歷史性拋售，引發市場猜測，美國可能進一步將舉債結構轉向較短期限。美國財政部週四晚些時候將進行250億美元30年期國債月度標售。在債券實際標售前進行交易的預發行市場上，這隻新債的預期收益率約為5.24%，若最終達到這一水平，將是2001年以來最高的融資成本。在11月中期選舉前，這對美國總統唐納德·特朗普和財政部長斯科特·貝森特而言都是一個棘手問題。經歷多年高通脹和政府支出高企後，政府融資成本居高不下，已經開始傳導至更廣泛的經濟領域。

Czechia Current Account Deficit Largest Since 2022 — The Czech Republic’s current account deficit widened to CZK 80.5 billion in June 2026 from CZK 64.2 billion in the corresponding month a year earlier, far exceeding market expectations of CZK 46.8 billion. This marked the largest deficit since August 2022, as the primary income deficit widened to CZK 125.7 billion from CZK 113.2 billion, while the secondary income deficit rose sharply to CZK 1.7 billion from CZK 0.3 billion. Meanwhile, the goods surplus narrowed to CZK 34.8 billion from CZK 41.5 billion. Conversely, the services surplus increased to CZK 10.8 billion from CZK 9.3 billion.

US Producer Prices Seen Rising 0.2% — US producer prices likely increased by 0.2% month-over-month in July 2026, following a 0.3% fall in June. Core producer prices, which exclude the more volatile food and energy components, are forecast to rise by 0.3% in July, accelerating from the 0.2% increase recorded in June. On an annual basis, headline producer inflation is projected to slow to 4.9%, down from 5.5% in June and marking its highest level in four months. Meanwhile, annual core producer inflation is expected to decrease to 4.2% from 4.7%, also reaching its lowest reading since March.

【Economist: UK Q2 growth driven by temporary factors; Bank of England September hike unlikely】Suren Thiru, chief economist at the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales (ICAEW), said the 0.4% Q2 GDP rise was mainly driven by temporary factors—pre‑Iran‑war stockpiling, unusually warm weather and World Cup activity—rather than underlying momentum. He expects a clearer slowdown in Q3 as rising inflation and energy costs squeeze household incomes, and said a Bank of England rate increase in September remains unlikely given market expectations that weaker activity will help rein in inflation.

Palestine CPI Slides 43% in July — Consumer prices in Palestine fell 43.19% year-on-year in July 2026, deepening from a 40.04% decline in June and marking another sharp drop in consumer prices. The continued year-on-year decline largely reflects the normalization of prices in Gaza following the exceptionally high price levels recorded previously. Prices in the Gaza Strip plunged 66.27%, while prices increased 1.90% in Jerusalem J1 and 1.67% in the West Bank. On a monthly basis, the CPI fell 1.68% in July, compared with a 1.6% decline in June. The monthly drop was driven by lower prices for eggs (-8.20%), fresh vegetables (-5.19%), petrol (-4.11%), diesel (-3.12%), fresh fruit (-2.41%), gas (-2.10%), fresh chicken (-1.61%), and vegetable oils (-1.40%).

【Deutsche Bank: UK growth may slow in H2 2026 but upside revisions possible】Deutsche Bank analyst Sanjay Raja says the UK economy is likely to slow in H2 2026 but could see upward revisions if current resilience continues. Q2 GDP rose 0.4%, leaving H1 annualized growth at 2%, and the UK appears to have ranked top among G7 economies for growth for a second consecutive quarter. Raja warns downside from an energy shock as rising fuel bills squeeze households and firms, and expects sequential growth in H2 to be nearer 0.1% while noting some modest upside risks that could prompt forecast upgrades.

Norges Bank Keeps Interest Rate at 4.25% — The Norges Bank kept its policy rate steady at 4.25% in August, in line with market expectations, as inflation slowed more than anticipated over the summer. CPI inflation fell to 3% in July, while underlying inflation declined to 2.7%. However, both measures remain above the central bank’s 2% target, meaning policymakers believe it is too early to conclude that inflation is sustainably moving lower. The Bank therefore maintained its restrictive monetary policy stance and warned that another rate hike could still be necessary. Economic activity and labour-market conditions have developed broadly as expected, although housing prices fell sharply in July and construction remains weak. The krone has recovered somewhat after weakening earlier in the summer. The next major signal will come in September, when new economic forecasts are published and policymakers reassess the future path of interest rates.

【劉文祥麻辣燙回應“店員徒手抓取食材”：已要求門店停業整改】8月12日，有網友發影片反映，廣州天河區沙河頂地鐵站附近的一家劉文祥麻辣燙門店，店員在製作外賣訂單時，直接徒手抓取食材。影片顯示，一位店員一手拿著食材桶和外賣訂單，另一手直接抓取製作外賣的食材，全程未佩戴工作帽和手套。8月13日，記者嘗試與影片釋出者取得聯絡，但截至發稿時，對方暫未回覆。同日，記者查詢並致電劉文祥麻辣燙沙河頂門店，經門店店長核實，影片中的門店確實是他們店。店長表示，按照規定，所有員工上崗必須佩戴工作帽，拿取食材時需佩戴手套。店長稱，影片中的店員是門店近期新入職的員工，可能由於訂單較多，忙起來之後忘記佩戴手套。“按規定必須要戴手套的，我們在忙的時候，他就有可能忘戴了。”同時，店長表示，門店此前就已決定要辭退該員工，後續也會加強對員工的培訓，避免此類事情發生。隨後，該店長告訴記者，公司已關注相關情況，要求門店在24小時內完成整改。“公司已經說了，24小時之內整改，停業24小時。”（湖北經視）

FTSE MIB Hovers at Record Levels — The FTSE MIB rose to around 53,900 on Thursday, remaining close to record levels, as stabilizing energy prices supported investor sentiment and eased some concerns around inflation expectations. Its peers also started higher, including Intesa Sanpaolo (+0.8%), Unipol Gruppo (+0.9%), Banca Mediolanum (+1.1%), and Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena (+1%). Saipem also rose 0.9% after announcing a new offshore EPCI contract in the Middle East, valued at approximately $1.8 billion. Other notable gainers were defense stocks Leonardo, Fincantieri, and Avio, which added 0.6%, 1.6%, and 1.7%, respectively.

Brent Halts 6-Day Rally — Brent crude fell below $88 a barrel on Thursday, ending a six-session rally as investors shifted their focus toward weakening demand prospects and continued disruption around the Strait of Hormuz. The International Energy Agency lowered its global oil demand outlook, warning that the prolonged Middle East conflict and higher prices are increasingly weighing on consumption. The agency estimates the global oil market could face a supply shortfall of 1.8 million barrels a day this quarter, more than twice its previous forecast, while supply remained 6.3 million barrels a day below year-earlier levels in July. Meanwhile, US crude inventories surged by 17.4 million barrels last week, their largest weekly increase since January 2023. Diplomatic efforts between the US and Iran to end the conflict and reopen Hormuz have made little progress, with attacks on shipping continuing and rhetoric intensifying. Despite Thursday’s decline, Brent remained nearly 5% higher for the week.

【Iran vows prolonged campaign to wear down US】IRGC senior adviser Mohammad Reza Naqdi told PBS on Aug. 11 that Washington’s two main war objectives — toppling Iran’s leadership and fracturing the country — “have failed” and “victory is on Iran’s side.” He said the US appears confused, repeatedly announcing new aims and turning the campaign into a “war without strategy.” Naqdi added that in more than five months of combat against the US, Iran has gained experience and found US forces weaker than expected. He said Iran must establish deterrence and that one method is to “prolong the war” to exhaust the US so future attackers will rethink the costs.

French Stocks Hover Near Flat — The CAC 40 hovered near the flatline at around 8,687 on Thursday, following the previous session's decline as investors remained cautious amid conflicting signals over efforts to secure a lasting ceasefire between the US and Iran. While reports indicated that Washington and Tehran had agreed to extend a 60-day ceasefire brokered by Pakistan, tensions remained elevated after Iran threatened to prolong the conflict until the end of President Donald Trump's term and again rejected his claims that the US has "total control" over the Strait of Hormuz. Offsetting some geopolitical concerns, softer-than-expected US inflation data reinforced expectations that the Federal Reserve will keep interest rates unchanged at its September meeting. Among the index heavyweights, gains were led by LVMH (0.5%), L'Oréal (0.4%), TotalEnergies (0.5%), and Hermès (0.9%). In contrast, STMicroelectronics (-1%), Dassault Systèmes (-0.9%), and Air Liquide (-0.4%) were among the notable decliners.

【UK economy temporarily weathers energy shock but outlook remains challenged】National Institute of Economic and Social Research economist Fergus Jimenez-England said the UK has so far resisted the recent energy-price shock better than many feared. Q2 GDP rose 0.4% following a 0.6% gain in Q1. Services output increased 0.4% in June, offsetting declines in construction and industrial production. Jimenez-England warned the recent growth pace may be hard to sustain; he expects inflation and unemployment to rise in coming months, and said business confidence is fragile and could weaken further if energy-price volatility continues. Poland Inflation Confirmed at 3.0% in July — The annual inflation rate in Poland accelerated to 3.0% year-on-year in July 2026 from 2.5% in the previous month, confirming preliminary estimates. The pickup was mainly driven by faster price growth for transport (7.0% vs 1.3% in June), reflecting a sharp rebound in transport costs, and alcoholic beverages and tobacco (6.9% vs 6.5%). Inflation also accelerated for information and communication (5.2% vs 4.0%) and recreation, sport and culture (5.4% vs 5.2%). In contrast, prices continued to decline for clothing and footwear (-3.6% vs -3.1%), while inflation eased for housing and utilities (4.5% vs 4.9%), health (4.9% vs 5.0%), education services (5.3% vs 6.0%), and restaurants and accommodation services (4.2% vs 4.5%). Food prices remained in deflation (-0.4% vs -0.2%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.8%, rebounding from a 0.5% decline in June.

UK Natural Gas Dips — UK natural gas prices fell below 148 pence a therm on Thursday but remained more than 8% higher so far this week, as supply concerns persisted amid uncertainty over efforts to resolve the Middle East conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Talks between the US and Iran appear to have hit an impasse, with both sides taking a firmer stance and President Trump insisting that Washington has full control of the key waterway and intends to keep it that way. Shipping disruptions have sharply curtailed LNG flows from the Gulf, significantly delaying cargoes from major exporter Qatar and making it difficult for Europe to rebuild gas inventories ahead of winter. Analysts anticipate European gas prices will maintain a firm floor until storage levels show clearer signs of building before the heating season begins. At the same time, intense summer heatwaves across Southern and Central Europe have ramped up gas-fired power generation to meet cooling needs, diverting supplies from storage.

【AI surge pushes KOSPI into technical bull market; durability questioned】South Korea’s KOSPI rose 3.21% on Thursday, completing a more-than-20% rebound from the July 30 close low and entering a technical bull market; SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics gained about 6% and 4% respectively. The index had plunged 22% in July, its worst monthly drop since the global financial crisis. KB Securities global investment strategist Peter Kim said the AI-led rally and earnings upside were present through the selloff, arguing fundamentals—not valuations—are driving the market rebound; he cited technical factors and flows as the root of the prior selloff and said regulator tightening and brokers’ resumption of normal risk controls have eased forced deleveraging. Phillip Wool, head of research at Ruilian Caizhi, said the market is effectively trading as an AI-hardware market: the rebound reflects receding forced selling, dip-buying and FOMO, and has been supported by stronger-than-expected results that lift AI spend and hardware earnings forecasts; he warned a setback—such as weak capex guidance or renewed Fed tightening—could prompt a pullback. Global X strategist Billy Leung said corporate-governance and value-unlocking plans should help narrow Korea’s valuation discount, and he leans toward a fundamentals-led rally given rising semiconductor profit forecasts, but rising retail participation and index concentration show early late-cycle signals. Fibonacci Asset Management CEO Zheng Renyun urged caution: his base case is a broader bull trend supported by semiconductor earnings and improved risk appetite, but he expects the pace to slow and for consolidation after sharp gains.

Hungary Industrial Output Hits Over 3-Year High — Industrial production in Hungary soared 10.1% year-on-year in June 2026, confirming preliminary estimates and following a 0.4% decline in the previous month. This marked the strongest growth since September 2022, as manufacturing output, which accounts for 96% of total industrial production, climbed 10.8% in June after stagnating in May. Production rebounded in transport equipment (21.0% vs -0.5% in May), electrical equipment (1.8% vs -2.6%), rubber and plastic products and other non-metallic mineral products (2.8% vs -3.2%), and basic metals and fabricated metal products, except machinery and equipment (8.1% vs -3.0%), while output of computer, electronic and optical products rose faster (49.7% vs 42.1%). Additionally, production accelerated in mining and quarrying (60.8% vs 43.7%), while electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply rebounded (0.3% vs -9.9%). On a seasonally and working-day adjusted basis, industrial output fell 1.4% in June, reversing a 2.7% increase in May.

Shell and BP declined 0.4% and 1%, respectively, while miners suffered steeper losses as gold, silver and copper prices retreated. Antofagasta fell more than 5%, Rio Tinto dropped 4.5% and Anglo American declined 3%. Precious-metal miners Fresnillo and Endeavour also lost more than 3% each. Meanwhile, Entain reported stronger-than-expected operational profitability and reaffirmed that it remains comfortable with its full-year expectations.

【著手AI成本可預見性 Compute Exchange推出詞元遠期合約】海量資金即將湧入晶片與資料中心賽道，各家企業持續大手筆投入AI技術自研，幾乎所有相關參與方都在想方設法，提升自身投入與收益的可預測性。據報道，初創算力交易平臺Compute Exchange原本業務是撮合GPU持有方與短期租用者，現在拓展同類撮合業務，推出詞元遠期合約（Token forwards）。這屬於場外私下協商合約，允許企業最長鎖定未來六個月的詞元採購價格，對沖後續AI使用成本波動風險。 詞元遠期合約的定價模式和GPU合約存在區別：GPU合約一般鎖定執行AI模型所需算力的小時單價；詞元合約則在更長週期內鎖定統一價格，交易標的也是企業日常業務真正消耗的資源。 客戶可選擇六家簽約推理服務商提供的多款主流開源權重模型。遠期合約和CME籌備的標準化場內期貨並不完全等同，但標誌著金融市場套保機制，進一步延伸到更多型別AI成本專案。

Slovakia Inflation Eases to 19-Month Low — Slovakia's annual inflation rate eased to 3.3% in July 2026 from 3.5% in June, remaining above market expectations of 3%. It was the lowest reading since December 2024, largely due to a deeper decline in food and non-alcoholic beverage prices (-2.1% vs -0.5%). Inflation also slowed for alcoholic beverages, tobacco and narcotics (1.8% vs 3.1%), insurance and financial services (4.6% vs 4.9%), and miscellaneous goods and services (2.6% vs 3.2%). Meanwhile, price growth accelerated for housing and utilities (7.4% vs 7.3%), transport (7.0% vs 5.3%), clothing and footwear (0.8% vs 0.6%), health (5.1% vs 4.9%), information and communication (2.2% vs 2.0%), and recreation, sport and culture (5.2% vs 4.8%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.1%, compared with market expectations and the previous month's 0.1% decline. Core inflation, which excludes regulated prices, edged down to 1.7% from 1.9% in June, marking its lowest level since March 2021.

India 10Y Yield Holds Near 4-Week Low — The yields on India’s 10-year G-Sec weakened to around 6.76%, hovering near four-week lows as inflation data from India and the US reinforced expectations that neither central bank is likely to raise rates soon. Market participants assessed India’s July CPI, which rose to 4.45% from 4.38% in June, below the 4.50% forecast and comfortably within the RBI’s tolerance range. Meanwhile, US annual inflation slowed to 3.4% in July from 3.5% in June, marginally reducing expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike next month and supporting US Treasuries. However, the decline in Indian yields remained limited as Brent crude held around $88 per barrel, keeping inflation risks in focus for the world’s third-largest oil importer. The US 10-year Treasury yield also remained elevated, while market participants shifted their attention to Friday’s INR 320 billion government bond auction, which is expected to provide the next major direction for yields.

UK economic data also offered encouragement, showing that the region’s economies have so far proved resilient to the energy shock. UK GDP expanded by 0.4% in the second quarter, while growth strengthened in June. Corporate earnings provided an additional boost. Iron Ore Falls on Demand Worries — Iron ore futures declined toward CNY 700 per ton, approaching 14-month lows as weak profitability among Chinese steelmakers continues to constrain the potential for a meaningful recovery in ore demand. Recent data also showed China imported 108.086 million tons of iron ore and concentrates in July, down 4.09% from June but still 3.5% higher than a year earlier. Meanwhile, slower consumer and producer inflation in China last month pointed to persistent weakness in domestic demand. On the supply side, however, tightening shipments continued to offer some support to prices. Industry data showed global iron ore shipments fell by 1.38 million tons in the week through August 9 to around 32 million tons, while volumes arriving at Chinese ports dropped by 13.1 million tons to 18.9 million tons.

Spain July Inflation Rate Revised Slightly Up to 3.6% — Spain's annual inflation rate was revised slightly higher to 3.6% in July 2026 from a preliminary estimate of 3.5% and June's reading of 3.2%. This marked the highest rate since May 2024, mainly driven by fuel and lubricant prices for personal vehicles, which increased more than in July 2025. The core inflation rate, excluding unprocessed food and energy, also rose to 3.0% from 2.9% in June, in line with estimates and matching May’s near two-year peak. The EU-harmonized annual rate hit 3.9%, its highest since February 2023, up from 3.6% in June and above the preliminary estimate of 3.8%. On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose by 0.3%, up from the earlier estimate of 0.2%, but easing from the 0.6% increase recorded in June.

Lithuania Current Account Surplus Widens in June — Lithuania’s current account surplus widened sharply to EUR 437.5 million in June 2026 from EUR 191.5 million in the same month a year earlier. The services account surplus increased to EUR 985.4 million from EUR 791.9 million, while the secondary income account shifted to a EUR 346.5 million surplus from a deficit of EUR 17.9 million. On the other hand, the goods account deficit widened to EUR 695.1 million from EUR 408.5 million, driven largely by a larger increase in imports, which rose by EUR 824.7 million to EUR 4,175.1 million, compared with a EUR 538.1 million increase in exports to EUR 3,480 million. Turkey Current Account Deficit Widens in June — Turkey's current account deficit widened to $4.19 billion in June 2026 from $2.27 billion in the same month a year earlier, but came in below the expected $5.0 billion shortfall. The goods deficit increased to $8.53 billion from $6.52 billion, while the services surplus rose to $6.85 billion from $6.09 billion. The primary income deficit widened to $1.79 billion from $1.76 billion, while the secondary income deficit increased to $0.73 billion from $0.08 billion. Excluding gold and energy, the current account recorded a $1.46 billion surplus. In the first half of the year, the cumulative current account deficit reached $34.55 billion. On an annualized basis, the current account deficit reached $38.9 billion in June, with the goods deficit at $76.5 billion and the services surplus at $63.7 billion.

Aluminum Extends Decline — Aluminum futures in the UK fell to around $3,270 per tonne, retreating further from a seven-week high, after Emirates Global Aluminium reaffirmed its timeline to restore full production at the Al Taweelah smelter by Q1 next year, easing concerns over supply from the Gulf. The company was forced to cut output after the smelter was hit by Iranian missiles and drones during the early stages of the war. The restoration is expected to improve supply prospects from the Middle East, which accounted for around 10% of global aluminum production prior to the conflict. Prices had jumped recently amid lower feedstock production at Norsk Hydro’s plant in Brazil, adding to concerns over Gulf supply as uncertainty persisted over a deal that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a key export route for regional smelters. Further easing supply fears, the owners of Australia’s largest aluminum smelter secured a $1.8 billion government bailout, allowing operations to continue.

【Tariff refunds hit corporate books, temporarily lifting U.S. profits】After the U.S. Supreme Court ruled portions of tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act lacked legal authority, refunds have begun appearing in corporate filings. More than 40 S&P 500 companies have disclosed roughly $9.6bn in refunds, led by Apple (~$2.2bn), Nike (~$986m) and FedEx (~$800m). Apple reported EPS of $2.02 for the quarter, with refunds adding $0.11 and boosting gross margin by about 2 percentage points. These payments are reversals of past tariff costs, not signs of stronger demand or operating improvement, and should not be extrapolated as recurring profit gains. The impact will vary by firm: FedEx says it largely paid duties on behalf of customers and plans to return about $800m to shippers and consumers, while some retailers may retain refunds or use them to cut prices. In the near term refunds support cash flow and margins for import-heavy firms, but they should be stripped out when assessing underlying earnings trends.

【Mecca joint defence pact raises Middle East order uncertainty — nascent alliance or strategic hedge?】Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan have signed a Mecca joint defence pact that could shift regional power dynamics by enhancing members' autonomous deterrent capacity and easing some US security burdens, though its operational credibility remains uncertain. A Foundation for Defense of Democracies expert says the agreement appears more focused on economic and commercial cooperation than on a NATO‑style security alliance; its deterrent value depends on joint planning, command arrangements and crisis procedures. A Pakistani policy analyst at CUNY warned the pact should not be read as an Article‑5 equivalent for now. Even a limited military arrangement may harden alignments—prompting counter‑cooperation from countries such as Israel and Greece—and therefore raise geopolitical tensions in the region.

Hungary Construction Output Decline Eases in June — Hungary’s construction output fell by 1.2% year-on-year in June 2026, easing sharply from a 10.7% decline in the previous month. The decline was driven by a 5.5% contraction in building construction from 4.6% increase in May. Meanwhile output in other construction increased 5.6% from slumping 14.9% in the previous month, supported by a 28.3% rise in civil engineering, mainly due to a 49.6% expansion in road and railway construction. Meanwhile, production in specialised construction, the industry’s largest segment, rose 0.6% from a year earlier. On a seasonally and working-day adjusted monthly basis, construction activity fell by 3.9% in June, following the previous month’s increase. In the first half of 2026, total construction output declined by 0.7% compared with the same period a year earlier.

Swiss Producer and Import Prices Fall Again in July — Switzerland’s producer and import prices dropped by 2.1% year-on-year in July 2026, the same pace as in the previous month and extending a more than three-year deflationary streak. The latest figure also remained the sharpest annual decline since March, reflecting continued weakness in both domestic and imported prices. Producer prices continued to decline (-2.3% vs -2.7% in June), driven by lower prices mainly for agricultural and forestry products (-5.8%), electricity and gas supply (-6.9%), and water treatment and distribution (-4%). Import prices also declined further (-1.5% vs -0.8%), as costs dropped for mining and quarrying products (-19.5%) and manufacturing products (-0.9%), which more than offset an increase in agricultural products (1.7%). On a monthly basis, producer and import prices fell by 0.1% in July, following a 0.3% decrease in June and marking a third consecutive monthly drop, mainly driven by lower petroleum-related prices.

UK Business Investment Growth Accelerates — Business investment in the United Kingdom rose by 1.7% quarter-on-quarter in the three months to June 2026, exceeding market expectations of a 0.5% decline and accelerating from 0.9% in the previous period, according to preliminary estimates. This marked the strongest growth since the first quarter of 2025, highlighting a continued recovery in corporate spending. The increase was largely driven by a significant rise in spending on ICT equipment and other machinery and equipment, while investment declined mainly in intellectual property products. On an annual basis, business investment grew 0.8% in the second quarter, rebounding from a 1.3% decline in the fourth quarter. Meanwhile, overall gross fixed capital formation increased by 0.4% quarter-on-quarter and 1.6% year-on-year.

Saudi Wholesale Inflation Highest Since 2022 — Saudi Arabia’s wholesale price inflation rose to 5.0% year-on-year in July 2026 from 4.8% in the previous month, the sharpest growth since August 2022. Prices increased for agriculture and fishery products (6.2% vs 4.0%) and other transportable goods, excluding metal products, machinery, and equipment (9.7% vs 9.3% in June), driven largely by higher costs for basic chemicals (66.7% vs 62.0%). At the same time, deflation slowed for ores and minerals (-0.1% vs -0.5%). In contrast, costs declined for food products, beverages, and tobacco, and textiles (-0.6% vs 0.2%), while price growth moderated for metal products, machinery, and equipment (1.5% vs 1.6%). On a monthly basis, wholesale prices recorded a flat reading in July, easing from a 0.2% rise in the preceding period.

【Beijing Property Rights Exchange launches platform to accelerate monetization of existing assets】Beijing Property Rights Exchange said it has built a “platform + investment bank” trading ecosystem and launched a dedicated existing-asset revitalization service column to help monetize stock assets. The column targets 14 asset categories, including equity and debt transfers, real estate and land transfers/leases, machinery and disposal of idle/scrap assets. The exchange offers one-stop services — advisory, asset valuation/price discovery, due diligence and site inspection, marketing and promotion, transaction matching, and financing — intended to raise transaction efficiency, cut transaction costs and maximize asset value.

UK Construction Output Falls for 8th Straight Month — UK construction output contracted 2.3% year-on-year in June 2026, deepening from a revised 2.0% decline in the prior month and marking the eighth consecutive month of contraction. Still, the fall was slightly milder than the 2.4% decline expected by markets. New work fell for a ninth straight month (-5.9% vs -6.5% in May), while growth in repair and maintenance eased to a six-month low (2.8% vs 4.6%). On a monthly basis, construction output edged down 0.1%, significantly less than the 0.8% decline in May, although it marked a third consecutive monthly drop. The softer decline reflected stagnant repair and maintenance activity, while new work fell 0.3%, extending its monthly contraction streak. Despite the weak June reading, output rose 0.3% over the three months to June, marking a fourth consecutive increase in the rolling measure. Growth was supported by both new work (0.4%) and repair and maintenance activity (0.2%).

Romania Industrial Output Decline Eases Slightly — Industrial output in Romania declined by 5.2% year-on-year in June 2026, easing slightly from a 5.3% drop in May, which was the sharpest fall since March 2025. The contraction moderated in mining and quarrying (-0.5% vs -4.8% in May) and electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply (-2.5% vs -3.1%). In contrast, manufacturing output fell further (-6.0% vs -5.5%), weighed down by declines in beverages (-9.7% vs -8.5%), coke and refined petroleum products (-21.6% vs -13.9%), chemicals and chemical products (-14.1% vs -1.6%), pharmaceuticals and pharmaceutical preparations (-7.5% vs -0.3%), and motor vehicles, trailers and semi-trailers (-15.5% vs -15.3%). On a monthly basis, industrial output fell by a softer 0.7% in June, following a 2.8% decline in May. In the January-June, industrial production was 3.5% lower than in the corresponding period last year.

UK Manufacturing Output Falls More Than Expected — Manufacturing production in the UK fell 0.5% month-on-month in June 2026, worse than market expectations and May's downwardly revised 0.2% drop. Output contracted in seven of the thirteen manufacturing subsectors, with the largest negative contributions coming from the manufacture of basic pharmaceutical products and preparations (-5.1% vs 0.2% in May), alongside computer, electronic and optical products (-0.9% vs 2.1%), and machinery and equipment not elsewhere classified (-0.1% vs 3.4%). Meanwhile, production rebounded in the manufacture of food products, beverages and tobacco (1.0% vs -0.1%), coke and refined petroleum products (0.4% vs -1.0%), rubber and plastic products and non-metallic mineral products (0.4% vs -1.9%), and other manufacturing and repair activities (3.2% vs -1.4%). On an annual basis, manufacturing output growth slowed to a four-month low of 0.5% from a downwardly revised 2.0% in May, falling short of market expectations for a 1.2% increase.

【世界足夠大，容得下C919與波音、空客一起飛】中國是全球最大民航市場之一，航空需求持續增長。中國商飛預測，到2044年，全球客機機隊規模將超過5萬架，是2024年機隊的2.05倍，而2025至2044年全球交付的新客機中，約74.59%將為單通道噴氣客機。目前，全球現役單通道幹線客機市場仍由空客、波音長期壟斷，佔據90%以上的市場份額。據行業研究報告分析，未來15年中國窄體幹線飛機年均需求量約為300架。這麼大的蛋糕，以C919目前的產能僅能覆蓋其中一小部分，更不用說國際市場了。顯然，C919的出現，為快速增長的市場填補了空缺，此消彼長、你輸我贏不是這裡的邏輯。（環球時報）

【Anthropic投資方押注其創下 IPO 紀錄，估值有望達到 2 萬億美元】投資方預計，人工智慧初創企業Anthropic將於 10 月掛牌上市，估值達到 2 萬億美元乃至更高。這一驚人估值將超越SpaceX，讓這家 AI 實驗室創下史上規模最大的首次公開募股紀錄。六位該公司投資方透露，憑藉營收迅猛攀升，Anthropic計劃於今年秋季上市，估值較當前水平有望翻一倍以上。倘若以此估值完成上市，這家成立五年的企業早期投資方將斬獲數十億美元收益。Anthropic投資方表示，市場對公司高階人工智慧模型與工具的需求持續暴漲，足以支撐這般超高估值預期。投資方測算，按照企業採用的營收統計口徑（依據近期經營表現推算全年營收），這家Claude大模型研發企業在 2026 年末年化營收將介於 1000 億至 1200 億美元之間，全年營收漲幅超十倍。其中一位投資方說道：“倘若Anthropic年度增速能夠達到 800%，即便保守估算，其營收市盈率也能達到 30 倍，對應企業總市值便可達 3 萬億美元。”

【思科：AI代理催生“網路超級週期”，AI訂單激增4.5倍印證行業拐點】思科於8月13日釋出2026財年第四季度及全年業績，Q4營收創歷史新高，達173億美元，同比增長18%;全年營收首次突破630億美元，同比增長12%，非GAAP每股收益增長14%至4.33美元。公司指出，代理式AI的加速採用正催生“網路超級週期”，超大規模客戶AI基礎設施訂單全年達93億美元，約為上年的4.5倍。 思科董事長兼執行長查爾斯·羅賓斯在電話會表示：“我們相信，代理式人工智慧(Agentic AI)的加速採用正催生一輪網路超級週期。”

Swedish Inflation Confirmed at 0.2% in July — Consumer prices in Sweden rose by 0.2% year-on-year in July 2026, confirming preliminary estimates and slowing from a 0.7% increase in the previous month. The latest figure also marked the softest rise since May last year, driven largely by lower prices for food and non-alcoholic beverages (-7.2% vs -6.8% in June), health (-6.4% vs -4.7%), and education services (-15.3% vs 3.4%). At the same time, inflation softened for housing and utilities (2.3% vs 4%) and transport (0.4% vs 3.5%). On the other hand, costs rebounded for clothing and footwear (0.4% vs -2.3%) and information and communication (1.4% vs -1.0%), while restaurants and accommodation services rose at a faster pace (3.5% vs 2.7%), reflecting seasonal price increases. On a monthly basis, consumer prices fell by 0.3%, the first decline in three months and reversing a 0.4% rise in June. Meanwhile, the CPI with a fixed interest rate (CPIF), the Riksbank’s target measure, rose 0.7% annually and fell 0.3% month-on-month in July.

【優步將在東京試點部署Robotaxi，預計2026年底啟動】8月13日，優步宣佈，優步日本已與日之丸交通簽署運營合作協議，將負責東京自動駕駛計程車試點專案的日常車隊運營，專案預計於2026年底啟動。日之丸交通將負責車輛清潔、維護、檢查、充電及車隊運營等工作，乘客可透過優步打車應用使用相關服務。該專案將採用日產聆風（LEAF）電動車，搭載英國自動駕駛技術公司Wayve的人工智慧駕駛技術。根據日本相關法律，載客運輸服務須由獲授權的計程車公司運營，因此試點初期將由日之丸交通作為獲授權運營商，經驗豐富的計程車司機也將作為安全員隨車監控。未來在獲得監管批准後，專案將逐步邁向完全無人駕駛。

【美銀：五礦資源上半年業績強勁，目標價升至12港元】美銀證券發表報告指，五礦資源上半年業績強勁，各項主要指標均表現突出。期內收入同比增長61%至45.4億美元，股東應占純利達8.97億美元，同比大升164%，超出該行預期，並已達到市場對2026財年全年預測的54%。強勁的盈利能力受惠於銷量增加、銅及副產品價格上升，以及較低的C1現金成本，帶動EBITDA升至27.3億美元，同比增長77%。由於供應靈活性有限，該行看好銅價前景。考慮到上半年業績勝預期及資產負債表大幅改善，該行上調2026至2028年盈利預測16%至22%，目標價由10.5港元上調至12港元，重申“買入”評級。

Saudi Arabia Inflation Unchanged for Third Month — The annual inflation rate in Saudi Arabia rose by 1.8% in July 2026, matching the pace from the previous two months and in line with market expectations. Prices increased for food and non-alcoholic beverages (1.5% vs 1.4% in June), housing and utilities (4.2% vs 3.5%), restaurants and hotels (2.0% vs 1.5%), and education (1.2% vs 1.1%). At the same time, costs remained unchanged for information and communication (at 0.6%) and clothing and footwear (at -0.4%), while prices fell at a softer pace for furnishings and household equipment (-0.5% vs -0.6%). In contrast, inflation moderated for tobacco (0.4% vs 0.5%), recreation and culture (2.4% vs 2.5%), insurance and financial services (1.4% vs 2.1%), transportation (1.4% vs 1.7%), health (0.3% vs 0.4%), and miscellaneous goods and services (2.9% vs 3.8%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices grew by 0.2%, unchanged from the previous three months and exceeding market expectations of a 0.1% increase.

UK Q2 Construction Orders Drop at Steeper Pace — UK construction orders fell 18.1% year-on-year in Q2 2026, deepening from an 11.9% decline in the prior period and marking the sharpest contraction since Q4 2023. The downturn was driven by a faster fall in orders for other work (-25.4% vs -19.0% in Q1), with private commercial orders also weakening (-28.5% vs -23.1%). Other infrastructure orders declined at a slower pace (-22.5% vs -36.5%), while private industrial orders surged (33.0% vs 3.6%). However, this was offset by a sharp slump in other new work excluding infrastructure (-45.8% vs 12.9%). New housing orders also lost momentum, rising 7.7% after a 15.8% increase in Q1, as private housing growth slowed (12.9% vs 17.7%) and public housing orders fell (-19.2% vs 4.0%). On a quarterly basis, construction orders declined 11.8%, matching Q1’s pace and extending the contraction to a third consecutive quarter.

UK Industrial Output Unexpectedly Falls — Industrial production in the UK fell 0.2% month-on-month in June 2026, defying market expectations of a 0.1% increase, albeit easing from a 0.7% drop in the previous month. Mining and quarrying output rebounded sharply (5.1% vs -5.1% in May), supported by a strong recovery in crude petroleum and natural gas extraction (6.2% vs -5.5%). In addition, declines eased in water supply, sewerage, and waste management activities (-1.5% vs -3.1%). On the other hand, manufacturing output remained under pressure (-0.5% vs -0.2%), weighed down primarily by production of basic pharmaceutical products and preparations (-5.1% vs 0.2%) and computer, electronic, and optical products (-0.9% vs 2.1%). On a quarterly basis, industrial production showed no growth. On a yearly basis, industrial output fell 0.2%, defying forecasts of 0.2% rise and reversing May’s 1% gain. It also marked the first annual decline since February.

UK Annual Growth Tops Forecasts — The UK economy expanded by 1.2% year-over-year in Q2 2026, accelerating from 0.9% growth in Q1 and exceeding the expected 1.1% expansion, preliminary estimates showed. Growth was supported by a 1.5% increase in services output, with information and communication and professional, scientific and technical activities among the largest contributors. Production output rose 0.3%, driven by manufacturing and mining and quarrying, while construction output fell 2.0%. On the expenditure side, household consumption increased 1.0%, while government consumption rose 1.4%. Gross fixed capital formation climbed 2.7%, supported by higher investment in information and communication technology and other machinery and equipment. Business investment increased 0.8%. Trade provided a drag on growth as exports increased 2.4%, while imports rose 2.9%.

【UK Q2 GDP Holds, Growth Seen Slowing in H2】ONS data showed GDP for the three months to June rose 0.4% QoQ, down from 0.6% in Q1 and in line with economists' forecasts. Services drove the expansion; May was flat and June rose 0.3% month-on-month (economists had forecast -0.1%). Analysts say the UK largely weathered the initial months of the Iran war and consumer spending supported activity in Q2, but the Bank of England and economists expect growth to weaken as the conflict’s full effects emerge. Momentum in 1H 2026 is expected to ease into a muted H2 as a 13% July increase in the energy price cap squeezes households and policy uncertainty has risen after Burnham became the UK’s seventh prime minister in over a decade.

UK Trade Deficit Widens in June — The United Kingdom's trade deficit increased to £5.54 billion in June 2026, up from an upwardly revised £3.46 billion in the previous month, as exports fell more than imports. Exports dropped 2.8% mom to £80.21 billion, while imports edged down 0.2% to a four-month low of £85.74 billion. Goods exports shed 6.4% to £32.95 billion, driven by lower shipments to both EU and non-EU countries, which dropped 7.4% and 5.4%, respectively. Exports to the EU declined mainly due to a fall in fuel and chemical exports. Meanwhile, exports to non-EU countries were mainly weighed down by lower machinery and transport equipment exports. Services exports edged down 0.1% to £47.25 billion. On the import side, goods imports fell 0.6% to a four-month low of £55.96 billion.

UK Economy Grows 0.3% in June — The UK economy grew by 0.3% month-on-month in June 2026, compared with zero growth in May and market expectations for no change. The expansion was mainly driven by a 0.4% increase in services output (vs 0.1% in May), with the largest positive contribution coming from professional, scientific and technical activities, particularly scientific research and development, which rose to its highest level since January 2025, as well as legal activities. This more than offset declines in production and construction, which fell 0.2% and 0.1%, respectively. On an annual basis, GDP rose 1.1%, slowing slightly from a revised 1.2% increase in May but exceeding the market forecast of 0.8%. GDP increased by 0.4% in the three months to June, following a revised 0.6% expansion in the previous three-month period.

【華爾街預言家：美國房市出現崩潰跡象，2008年危機訊號再現】有“華爾街預言家之稱”的前美林證券首席北美經濟學家羅森伯格（David Rosenberg）最新警告稱，從很多方面來看，美國房地產市場都陷入了困境。而最新資料顯示，這種情況與2008年金融危機爆發前夕的情況有著驚人的相似之處。羅森伯格表示，房地產市場的一個預警訊號在住房危機爆發前就會出現。他週三撰文指出，這個訊號就是房屋年銷售率的下降，最近已跌破2008年初的水平，而當時正是房地產崩盤爆發的開端。

【Omdia: Middle East smartphone shipments down 19% YoY in Q2 2026; vendors shift to profitability】Omdia reports Q2 2026 smartphone shipments in the Middle East (ex-Turkey) fell 19% YoY to 10.6 mln units, the largest single-quarter drop since Q4 2025. Price increases, supply constraints and geopolitical uncertainty are driving vendors to prioritise product value and profitability over volume growth, while weaker consumer confidence has led retailers to tighten inventory management.

UK Economy Expands 0.4% in Q2 — The UK economy expanded by 0.4% quarter-on-quarter in Q2 2026, slowing from 0.6% growth in Q1, in line with market expectations, preliminary estimates showed. Services output rose 0.5%, led by information and communication, which increased 2.7%, and professional, scientific and technical activities, which grew 1.7%. Production showed no growth as a 1.0% rise in manufacturing and a 0.2% increase in mining and quarrying were offset by declines in electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply and water, sewerage and waste management. Construction output increased 0.3%, supported by gains in both new work and repair and maintenance. On the expenditure side, growth was mainly driven by a 1.2% increase in gross fixed capital formation and a 0.3% rise in household consumption, while government consumption fell 0.3%. On an annual basis, UK GDP expanded 1.2%, picking up from 0.9% growth in Q1 and exceeding the expected 1.1% rise.

【高盛：萬億美元儲備在手 日本可復刻多輪“史詩級外匯干預”】據高盛測算，在日本當前總量約1萬億美元的美元外匯儲備中，約2000億美元為現金及現金等價物，這一規模與今年7月日本央行的歷史性匯率干預體量基本持平。 依託美聯儲工具加持，日本可靈活調動的干預資金上限進一步提升，為後續護盤操作築牢資金基礎。 “日本目前手握的流動資金，足以再度開展數輪堪比此前紀錄級別的大規模干預。”高盛研究院策略師卡倫·菲什曼（Karen Fishman）直言，“（儘管）現實中日本不會把這筆資金全部耗盡，但這足以說明，只要日本願意，就擁有充足能力持續開展干預。” 她補充道，理論上，藉助美聯儲工具，全部1萬億美元儲備均可轉化為流動資金。

Rupiah Steady Near IDR 17,870 — The Indonesian rupiah hovered around IDR 17,870 per U.S. dollar on Thursday, little changed from the prior session, as the dollar index steadied ahead of July’s U.S. PPI data for more clues on price pressures and the Fed’s policy outlook. Locally, fiscal discipline remained in focus as the government pledged to cap the 2026 deficit below 3% of GDP, as tax receipts surged over 23% yoy in January–July, underscoring stronger revenue collection. Meanwhile, the 2027 budget proposal, set for Friday, may sustain a consumption-driven orientation. Political attention also turned to Bank Indonesia leadership, with President Prabowo nominating Aida Budiman as senior deputy governor and Destry Damayanti as the sole candidate to succeed Perry Warjiyo. BI’s policy meeting next week, its first since Warjiyo’s exit, comes after 100bps of hikes in May–June to aid the rupiah. With July inflation hitting a three-month low of 2.88%, policymakers may gain room to weigh further tightening more cautiously.

【人民幣首超港元 登頂香港外匯交易最大貨幣對】香港財資市場公會（TMA）最新公佈的香港外匯市場半年度調查結果顯示，2026年4月，香港外匯交易日均成交額為9082億美元，其中美元兌人民幣交易量首次超越美元兌港元，躍居香港市場交投最活躍的貨幣對。具體來看，4月美元兌人民幣日均成交2740億美元，佔香港全部外匯交易的30.2%，超過美元兌港元的2402億美元（佔比26.4%）。其中，美元兌離岸人民幣交易額達2592億美元，成為主力。業內分析認為，香港以港元為本地貨幣，而美元兌人民幣卻成為其成交最活躍的貨幣對，這凸顯了香港長期以來的離岸人民幣業務樞紐定位。（上證報）

【RMB surpasses HKD to become Hong Kong's top FX pair】The Hong Kong Treasury Markets Association's semiannual FX survey shows average daily FX turnover in Hong Kong was $908.2 bln in April 2026. 【韓國總統李在明：房地產泡沫已不容忽視】韓國總統李在明週四在與幕僚的一次會議上表示，房地產是韓國面臨的一個重要問題，深刻影響著社會的方方面面，而房地產泡沫已經達到不容忽視的程度。“社會資源長期以來過度集中於房地產領域，加劇了社會兩極分化和不平等現象，”李在明稱。他指出，如果這種情況持續下去，韓國可能會像其他國家一樣，面臨“失去的20年或30年”。李在明表示，韓國必須動用一切可用手段和能力來解決房地產問題，這個問題就像“定時炸彈，威脅著人民生活和國家未來”。韓國必須完善供給、稅收和金融政策以實現市場正常化，推動住房市場恢復穩定。

NZX 50 Snaps 2-Day Losses, Closes 0.6% Higher — New Zealand's stocks rose 88 points, or 0.6%, to close at 13,825 on Thursday, erasing losses from the previous two sessions, tracking an upbeat session on Wall Street overnight as moderated inflation eased expectations of a Fed interest rate hike at its upcoming meeting. The broader index moved from its lowest level since August 3, reached a day earlier, mainly buoyed by gains from financials, consumer staples, healthcare, and industrials. Moderating oil prices also lifted sentiment as easing concerns over inflation reduced expectations of RBNZ monetary policy tightening. The fresh data also fueled sentiment, as the RBNZ's quarterly survey of expectations showed that business managers expect inflation to slow to 2.34% over the next two years in Q3 2026, marking the lowest reading since Q4 2025. Among the top movers were ANZ Group (5.2%), Mainfreight (3.1%), Westpac Banking Corp. (2.9%), A2 Milk (1.7%), Fisher & Paykel (1.4%), Freightways Group (1.1%), and Contact Energy (1.1%).

【國家機器人創新中心在金屬增材製造工藝研究方面取得進展】據國家機器人創新中心訊息，鐳射粉末床熔融（LPBF）是當下鈦合金精密構件增材製造的核心工藝，廣泛應用於航空航天、高階裝備、精密製造等關鍵領域。但傳統LPBF工藝製備的Ti-6Al-4V合金，微觀組織通常呈現為完全針狀馬氏體，導致其延展性顯著下降。行業普遍採用後續熱處理改善材料塑形，但這些方法仍存在強度-延展性權衡以及工藝冗餘，製造效率偏低的問題。針對這一問題，近日中心研發團隊提出了一種在粉末床熔融過程中進行原位層間鐳射重熔（ILRPBF）的全新工藝策略。該技術利用鐳射工藝獨特的快速熱迴圈特性來調控所製備Ti-6Al-4V合金的微觀組織，無需額外後續熱處理工序，在保持高強度的同時，提升了合金的延展性及製造效率。

【RBA assistant governor Kent's dovish remarks push AUD below 0.7050】Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said the Australian dollar slipped below 0.7050 in the Asian session after RBA assistant governor Kent delivered dovish remarks. Kent said financial conditions remain somewhat tight and that earlier three rate hikes are working as expected, adding that a weakening housing market often means policy need not further slow demand. CBA FX strategist Samara Hammoud expects falling house prices will weigh on household spending and forecasts the RBA will hold rates for now and cut twice in 2027.

【獨家 | 五糧液向經銷商髮禁令：第八代五糧液不得低於800元拋售，低價出貨將被處罰】8月13日，繼收緊渠道補貼後，五糧液再度加碼市場管控。《酒業內參》從經銷商等多方獨家獲悉，五糧液近期向經銷商通知，不得以低於800元/瓶的價格低價拋售第八代五糧液。同時，酒廠也將加強對低價出貨和竄貨經銷商的處罰，進一步穩固區域秩序。截至發稿前，五糧液暫無回應。 此前，《酒業內參》曾報道，7月底，五糧液收緊了對渠道經銷商的多項補貼投入，經銷商的第八代五糧液整體成本對比收緊前成本提高了約50元/瓶。 批發價格方面，彼時，第八代五糧液單箱批價大約浮動在4485元-4500元，單瓶批價約748元-750元/瓶。 或基於新政影響，截止目前，第八代五糧液單箱批價已升至約4600元-4650元，單瓶批價約767元-775元/瓶。

【中保研發布最新汽車零整比研究結果：新能源汽車維修負擔指數降約14%】中保研今日釋出第21期汽車零整比體系指標研究結果（資料採集日期為2025年12月31日），指標包括汽車零整比係數、汽車零整比100指數、維修負擔指數等。結果顯示，最新一期燃油車“汽車零整比100指數”為390.77%，較上期略降0.3個百分點。新能源汽車“汽車零整比100指數”為311.42%，較上期下降0.82個百分點。與保險賠付緊密相關的新能源汽車“維修負擔100指數”為23.81，較上期下降3.85，降幅為13.92%。其中，動力電池價格下降是本期新能源汽車維修負擔100指數下降的主要因素。

【Sichuan to bolster compute-park infrastructure, preemptively expand smart compute facilities】Sichuan published interim policies to advance compute-network construction, directing upgrades to compute-park infrastructure and urging direct connections between backbone and metro communications networks and compute parks. The province will accelerate a “millisecond computing” action plan, coordinate primary and backup power and support intelligent microgrids for parks. Financing for qualifying compute-park infrastructure will be prioritised via local government special bonds and policy financial tools. The plan backs shared compute services — including scheduling platforms, compute marketplaces and token factories — and aims to boost high-quality compute supply. For large-model training/inference and industry-model development, Sichuan calls for appropriately ahead-of-demand deployment of smart compute, accelerated construction of 10,000-card smart-compute clusters, and balanced allocation between general-purpose, smart and supercomputing resources to raise the smart-compute share. Key universities, research institutes, industry leaders and AI firms are encouraged to prioritise provincial compute resources; eligible users may receive compute vouchers.

【Sichuan to build 10,000+‑card compute clusters, explore high‑security facilities】Sichuan issued interim measures to accelerate its computing‑power network, backing construction of 10,000+‑card intelligent compute clusters. The province will target major telecom carriers and leading model developers to locate clusters in the Chengdu Plain compute core and the Panxi–NW Sichuan electricity‑compute integration belt, and will use fiscal, financial and green‑power policy tools to support large and extra‑large facilities while seeking inclusion in national special support. It will also explore high‑security compute facilities in tunnels and other concealed environments, inviting telecom SOEs and central enterprises to deploy modular, green, high‑density, high‑security computing sites.

【四川：建強成都平原算力核心區 打造攀西—川西北算電融合發展帶】《四川省推進算力網建設的若干政策措施（試行）》釋出。其中提到，建強成都平原算力核心區。做強天府資料中心叢集，聚焦成渝國家算力樞紐節點，著力推進成都、雅安、綿陽、德陽為主要承載地的算力核心區建設；打造攀西—川西北算電融合發展帶。支援涼山、甘孜、阿壩、攀枝花依託清潔能源資源，統籌佈局“源網荷儲”一體化大型算力設施，打造重點承接模型訓練、大資料分析、影視渲染、資料備份等非實時、可遷移算力需求的算電融合發展帶。

【四川：佈局建設萬卡級以上智算叢集，探索建設高安全算力設施】《四川省推進算力網建設的若干政策措施（試行）》釋出。其中提到，支援建設萬卡叢集。重點招引基礎電信運營商、頭部模型大廠在成都平原算力核心區、攀西—川西北算電融合發展帶佈局建設萬卡級以上智算叢集，綜合應用財政、金融、綠色電力等政策工具支援大型、超大型算力設施專案落地；探索建設高安全算力設施。支援利用隧洞等可用安全隱蔽環境，積極引入基礎電信運營商等專業央企，探索佈局模組化、綠色化、高密度、高安全算力設施。積極爭取有關專案納入國家專項支援。

【四川：完善算力園區基礎設施建設 適度超前佈局智算設施】《四川省推進算力網建設的若干政策措施（試行）》釋出。其中提到，完善算力園區基礎設施建設。推動通訊骨幹網、都會網路與算力園區直連，加快實施“毫秒用算”專項行動計劃。統籌佈局算力園區主供電源和備用電源，支援算力園區建設智慧微電網。透過地方政府專項債券、政策性金融工具等優先支援符合條件的算力園區基礎設施建設。支援建設算力排程平臺、算力超市、詞元（Token）工廠等算力公共服務設施。加強高質量算力供給。圍繞大模型訓練推理、行業模型開發等需求，適度超前佈局智算設施，加快建設萬卡級智算叢集，合理配置通算、智算、超算比例，不斷提高智算佔比。鼓勵重點高校、科研機構、行業龍頭企業及人工智慧領域重點企業優先使用省內算力資源，符合條件的可享受“算力券”支援政策。

【摩根士丹利：電力、勞動力瓶頸等因素將在未來幾年持續制約算力供應】摩根士丹利美國主題研究策略師Michelle Weaver日前表示，企業對AI的應用正加速落地，但算力供應受限仍是制約行業增長的瓶頸。"當前算力供應嚴重不足。算力正在成為一種稀缺資源，" Weaver週三在接受媒體採訪時表示。Weaver指出，算力瓶頸主要有兩個原因：一是缺少建設資料中心所需的勞動力，二是為資料中心供電的電力不足。人工智慧資料中心耗電量巨大，而新建發電設施、輸電網路及相關基礎設施需要數年時間。即使考慮到將比特幣挖礦設施改造利用、燃料電池等創新供電方案，Weaver估計仍存在10%至20%的電力缺口，這意味著未來數年算力仍將是受限且高價值的資源。這意味著，即便企業擁有足夠資金購買AI晶片並建設資料中心，但電力或勞動力不足也可能阻礙實際算力上線。除了電力和勞動力不足，政治因素也是AI算力供應擴張的阻力之一。Weaver還指出，隨著中期選舉臨近，日益高漲的反資料中心情緒給該行業帶來了挑戰。

【泰國呵叻府發生傷人事件 6人受傷】12日晚，泰國東北部呵叻府一處市場發生一起持刀和槍擊傷人事件，造成6人受傷。據現場目擊者稱，一個盜竊團伙12日晚在事發市場附近偷盜摩托車時被車主發現，團伙中一人逃跑後又帶同夥返回，他們持刀傷人，並用自制霰彈槍向人群射擊，共造成6人受傷，其中一人傷勢嚴重。警方接到報案後趕赴現場並逮捕一名嫌疑人。泰國總理阿努廷13日上午接受媒體採訪時對這一事件表示震驚，強調必須對泰國槍支援有制度進行結構性改革。

【印度謀求參與法國六代機研發專案】據《西班牙人報》網站8月10日報道，法國、德國、西班牙聯合研發未來空中作戰系統（FCAS）的三方合作宣告破裂後，只有法國率先明確推出後續方案。法國達索公司對外表態，如果德國與西班牙執意單獨推進自研路線，法國將獨立完成六代機研發工作。 與此同時，印度正全力爭取加入法國六代機專案。 印度國防部向印度議會國防常設委員會提交了專項進展報告。《新印度快報》援引報告內容稱，印方已“協同開展各項籌備工作，謀求加入”法國FCAS專案。（環球網）

【中集安瑞科旗下企業與上海聯風達成蒸發氣（BOG）提氦專案合作】中集安瑞科公眾號訊息，近期公司投資企業—山西天浩清潔能源有限公司（簡稱“山西天浩”），與上海聯風氣體股份有限公司（簡稱“上海聯風”）簽訂了相關合作協議。雙方將發揮各自優勢，建立戰略合作伙伴關係，投資建設蒸發氣（BOG）提氦專案，實現資源綜合利用與經濟效益最大化。未來山西天浩與上海聯風將共同拓展蒸發氣（BOG）提氦專案的資源綜合利用效率，實現經濟效益最大化。此次簽約專案投產後年產能預計為11萬m³99.999%（5N）高純氦氣。

【韓國SK Shipping與H-Line置換船隻，將締造亞洲最大液化天然氣運營商】Hahn & Co.旗下的兩家韓國公司SK Shipping和H-Line Shipping正在進行船隻和合同置換，此項交易將締造亞洲最大的液化天然氣(LNG)運輸船運營商。總部位於首爾的私募股權投資公司Hahn & Co.週四表示，SK Shipping將從H-Line接收16艘液化天然氣運輸船及相關長期合同，作為交換，SK Shipping將向H-Line提供12艘油輪及其合同，外加約3億美元現金。該交易將使SK Shipping的液化天然氣船隊規模增長一倍，達到32艘運輸船，使其成為全球第三大、亞洲最大的液化天然氣運輸船運營商。

【Vietnam central bank warns $77 billion funding gap could threaten financial stability】Vietnam’s central bank warned a funding shortfall that exceeds banks’ ability to raise funds could jeopardize financial stability, saying VND loan balances exceed deposits by roughly VND 20,000 billion (about $77 billion), a mismatch that poses risks to liquidity, interest rates and the safety of banking institutions. The government is pressing banks to ramp up lending to support a near-12% H2 growth target on the way to a double-digit 2026 growth goal; the prime minister met banking executives on Thursday.

【菲律賓First Gen或將以27億美元估值接受KKR的私有化要約】菲律賓First Gen公司週四表示，KKR提出的強制要約將使這家電力生產商的估值達到約1,654.4億比索(即27億美元)。First Gen週三披露稱，KKR提議從其母公司First Philippine Holdings 手中收購該公司8.43%的股份。這家電力生產商補充稱，此舉可能會觸發KKR對First Gen全部11.67%流通股（即36億股已發行普通股）發起強制要約收購。該要約收購將 支援 First Gen向菲律賓證券交易所 提交的 自願退市 申請。
FX Updates: New Zealand Dollar Drops by 0.45% — Top currency loser is New Zealand Dollar (-0.45%). Gains are led by Japanese Yen (0.08%).
【銳捷網路股價創新高】銳捷網路漲10.51%，報139.5元/股，股價再創新高，總市值突破1500億元，成交額達31.42億元。

【Japan protests Putin visit to disputed Northern Territories (Southern Kurils)】MOTEGI lodged a strong protest on the 13th after Putin landed on Etorofu Island in the Northern Territories (the Southern Kurils in Russian) and inspected a seafood-processing plant. The Kremlin said Putin spoke with workers, posed for photos and sampled local caviar; it was his first visit to the islands. The sovereignty dispute has prevented Russia and Japan from signing a post-World War II peace treaty.

【日本強烈抗議普京登上日俄爭議島嶼】13日，日本外務大臣茂木敏充就俄羅斯總統普京登上北方四島（俄稱南千島群島）的擇捉島（俄稱伊圖魯普島）提出強烈抗議。當天稍早前，普京登上南千島群島（日本稱北方四島），並視察了伊圖魯普島（日本稱擇捉島）上一家水產品加工廠。克里姆林宮在社交媒體釋出訊息說，普京與水產品加工廠員工交談，並與他們合影留念。他還品嚐了當地生產的魚子醬。這是普京首次登上南千島群島。因在南千島群島（日本稱北方四島）的歸屬問題上存在爭議，俄日在二戰結束後至今未締結和平條約。（央視新聞）
聯想在公佈營收超預期後，股價漲幅擴大至17%。

【太空算力硬體成本降至幾百元 全國產化太空伺服器亮相】太空算力，是將地面資料中心的人工智慧算力節點部署至太空軌道，利用太空充足太陽能與天然低溫環境，破解地面算力面臨的能耗、散熱和土地資源瓶頸。當前，全球算力需求持續增長，各國低軌衛星星座加速佈局，太空算力正成為新質生產力重要突破口。昨天（12日）《新質生產力發展大會——太空算力產業》在北京舉行，活動探討技術突破與產業發展，推動我國太空算力加速落地。活動現場，一家企業展示自主研發的航天級算力專用GPU晶片，把太空算力硬體成本從數萬元降至幾千元甚至幾百元。現場還亮相了全國產化太空伺服器，搭載雙核心星載作業系統，當遭遇宇宙高能粒子干擾時，可毫秒級切換備用核心，保障在軌算力不停機。（央視財經）
